entry.summary: Proposes ToProVAR for efficient Visual Autoregressive (VAR) model optimization using attention entropy analysis to identify sparsity patterns across token, layer, and scale dimensions, enabling fine-grained acceleration.

entry.title: Learning Continuous Wasserstein Barycenter Space for Generalized All-in-One Image Restoration

author.name: Xiaole Tang, Xiaoyi He, Jiayi Xu, Xiang Gu, Jian Sun

entry.summary: Proposes BaryIR for generalized all-in-one image restoration using Wasserstein barycenter space to align degraded features, targeting out-of-distribution degradation generalization.

entry.title: MediX-R1: Open Ended Medical Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sahal Shaji Mullappilly, Mohammed Irfan Kurpath, Omair Mohamed, Mohamed Zidan, Fahad Khan, Salman Khan, Rao Anwer, Hisham Cholakkal

entry.summary: Introduces MediX-R1, an RL framework for medical multimodal LLMs enabling free-form medical answers beyond multiple-choice. Uses group-based RL with composite rewards including LLM-based accuracy, medical embedding similarity, and format rewards.

entry.title: Rethinking the Practicality of Vision-language-action Model: A Comprehensive Benchmark and An Improved Baseline

author.name: Wenxuan Song, Jiayi Chen, Xiaoquan Sun, Huashuo Lei, Yikai Qin, Wei Zhao, Pengxiang Ding, Han Zhao, Tongxin Wang, Pengxu Hou, Zhide Zhong, Haodong Yan, Donglin Wang, Jun Ma, Haoang Li

entry.summary: Proposes CEBench, a comprehensive benchmark for VLA models spanning diverse embodiments in simulation and real world. Studies practicality of VLAs and proposes CEBot as an improved baseline.

entry.title: Multi-Level Causal Embeddings

author.name: Willem Schooltink, Fabio Massimo Zennaro

entry.summary: Develops a framework for causal embeddings that generalizes causal abstractions, enabling multiple detailed causal models to be mapped into sub-systems of a coarser model. Addresses the multi-resolution marginal problem for merging datasets from different representations.

entry.title: AMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Memory for Agentic Applications

author.name: Yujie Zhao, Boqin Yuan, Junbo Huang, Haocheng Yuan, Zhongming Yu, Haozhou Xu, Lanxiang Hu, Abhilash Shankarampeta, Zimeng Huang, Wentao Ni, Yuandong Tian, Jishen Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces AMA-Bench for evaluating long-horizon memory in agentic applications, distinguishing from dialogue-centric benchmarks by focusing on machine-generated agent-environment interactions of variable length.

entry.title: MiroFlow: Towards High-Performance and Robust Open-Source Agent Framework for General Deep Research Tasks

author.name: Shiqian Su, Sen Xing, Xuan Dong, Muyan Zhong, Bin Wang, Xizhou Zhu, Yuntao Chen, Wenhai Wang, Yue Deng, Pengxiang Zhu, Ziyuan Liu, Tiantong Li, Jiaheng Yu, Zhe Chen, Lidong Bing, Jifeng Dai

entry.summary: Proposes MiroFlow, an open-source agent framework featuring flexible agent graph orchestration, optional deep reasoning mode, and robust workflow with error recovery. Aims for high performance across diverse benchmarks without reliance on costly commercial APIs.

entry.title: Deep Sequence Modeling with Quantum Dynamics: Language as a Wave Function

author.name: Ahmed Nebli, Hadi Saadatdoorabi, Kevin Yam

entry.summary: Introduces a sequence modeling framework where latent states are complex-valued wave functions evolving under learned Hamiltonians on Hilbert space, using quantum interference instead of gating mechanisms. Token probabilities are extracted via the Born rule.

entry.title: Structure and Redundancy in Large Language Models: A Spectral Study via Random Matrix Theory

author.name: Davide Ettori

entry.summary: Uses Random Matrix Theory and spectral geometry to analyze LLM internal structure, showing that spectral statistics of hidden activations can separate structured representations from noise and identify redundancy across layers.

entry.title: HubScan: Detecting Hubness Poisoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Idan Habler, Vineeth Sai Narajala, Stav Koren, Amy Chang, Tiffany Saade

entry.summary: Introduces HubScan, a security scanner for detecting hubness poisoning in RAG vector indices, where certain items disproportionately appear in top-k retrieval results. Multi-detector architecture combining statistical, graph-based, and embedding-space analysis.

entry.title: Learning Tangent Bundles and Characteristic Classes with Autoencoder Atlases

author.name: Eduardo Paluzo-Hidalgo, Yuichi Ike

entry.summary: Introduces a theoretical framework connecting multi-chart autoencoders with vector bundles and characteristic classes from differential topology, showing that autoencoder atlases naturally define tangent bundles and provide access to topological invariants.

entry.title: Affine-Scaled Attention: Towards Flexible and Stable Transformer Attention

author.name: Jeongin Bae, Baeseong Park, Gunho Park, Minsub Kim, Joonhyung Lee, Junhee Yoo, Sunghyeon Woo, Jiwon Ryu, Se Jung Kwon, Dongsoo Lee

entry.summary: Affine-Scaled Attention extends standard softmax attention with input-dependent scaling and bias terms, relaxing the strict unit-sum normalization to provide more flexible control over attention magnitudes and reduce training instability.

entry.title: Efficient Encoder-Free Fourier-based 3D Large Multimodal Model

author.name: Guofeng Mei, Wei Lin, Luigi Riz, Yujiao Wu, Yiming Wang, Fabio Poiesi

entry.summary: Fase3D is the first efficient encoder-free 3D scene LMM, using point cloud serialization and Fast Fourier Transform for tokenization to avoid heavy pre-trained visual encoders while maintaining permutation invariance.

entry.title: SOTAlign: Semi-Supervised Alignment of Unimodal Vision and Language Models via Optimal Transport

author.name: Simon Roschmann, Paul Krzakala, Sonia Mazelet, Quentin Bouniot, Zeynep Akata

entry.summary: SOTAlign proposes a semi-supervised framework for aligning frozen pretrained vision and language models using optimal transport, requiring substantially fewer paired image-text samples by leveraging unpaired data.

entry.title: Global River Forecasting with a Topology-Informed AI Foundation Model

author.name: Hancheng Ren, Gang Zhao, Shuo Wang, Louise Slater, Dai Yamazaki, Shu Liu, Jingfang Fan, Shibo Cui, Ziming Yu, Shengyu Kang, Depeng Zuo, Dingzhi Peng, Zongxue Xu, Bo Pang

entry.summary: Presents GraphRiverCast (GRC), a topology-informed AI foundation model for simulating global river hydrodynamics that can operate without historical river data initialization, achieving strong performance in 7-day global pseudo-hindcasts.

entry.title: Generalization Bounds of Stochastic Gradient Descent in Homogeneous Neural Networks

author.name: Wenquan Ma, Yang Sui, Jiaye Teng, Bohan Wang, Jing Xu, Jingqin Yang

entry.summary: Derives generalization bounds for SGD in homogeneous neural networks showing that homogeneity enables slower stepsize decay (Ω(1/√t)) while maintaining generalization, applicable to fully-connected and convolutional architectures.

entry.title: Regularized Online RLHF with Generalized Bilinear Preferences

author.name: Junghyun Lee, Minju Hong, Kwang-Sung Jun, Chulhee Yun, Se-Young Yun

entry.summary: Studies online RLHF with generalized bilinear preferences capturing intransitive preferences, proving that the dual gap of greedy policy is bounded by squared estimation error under any strongly convex regularizer.

entry.title: InnerQ: Hardware-aware Tuning-free Quantization of KV Cache for Large Language Models

author.name: Sayed Mohammadreza Tayaranian Hosseini, Amir Ardakani, Warren J. Gross

entry.summary: Introduces InnerQ, a hardware-aware KV-cache quantization scheme that groups over the inner dimension to align dequantization with vector-matrix multiplication, reducing decode latency without accuracy loss.

entry.title: RETLLM: Training and Data-Free MLLMs for Multimodal Information Retrieval

author.name: Dawei Su, Dongsheng Wang

entry.summary: RetLLM introduces a training-free and data-free framework for multimodal information retrieval that prompts MLLMs to directly predict retrieval scores in a coarse-then-fine pipeline, avoiding pre-training inconsistency and large dataset requirements.

entry.title: LoBoost: Fast Model-Native Local Conformal Prediction for Gradient-Boosted Trees

author.name: Vagner Santos, Victor Coscrato, Luben Cabezas, Rafael Izbicki, Thiago Ramos

entry.summary: LoBoost introduces a model-native local conformal prediction method for gradient-boosted trees that reuses the ensemble's leaf structure to define multiscale calibration groups, improving adaptivity under heteroscedasticity without auxiliary models.

entry.title: Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising

author.name: Ben Xue, Dan Liu, Lixiang Wang, Mingjie Sun, Peng Wang, Pengfei Zhang, Shaoyun Shi, Tianyu Xu, Yunhao Sha, Zhiqiang Liu, Bo Kong, Bo Wang, Hang Yang, Jieting Xue, Junhao Wang, Shengyu Wang, Shuping Hui, Wencai Ye, Xiao Lin, Yongzhi Li, Yuhang Chen, Zhihui Yin, Quan Chen, Shiyang Wen, Wenjin Wu, Han Li, Guorui Zhou, Changcheng Li, Peng Jiang

entry.summary: GR4AD presents a production-oriented generative recommender for large-scale advertising, introducing Unified Advertisement Semantic IDs and LazyAR decoder that relaxes layer-wise dependencies for efficient multi-candidate generation.

entry.title: SIGMA: A Semantic-Grounded Instruction-Driven Generative Multi-Task Recommender at AliExpress

author.name: Yang Yu, Lei Kou, Huaikuan Yi, Bin Chen, Yayu Cao, Lei Shen, Chao Zhang, Bing Wang, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: SIGMA is a production generative multi-task recommender deployed at AliExpress that grounds items in semantic space and uses instruction-driven generation for diverse recommendation tasks, moving beyond simple next-item prediction.

entry.title: Low-degree Lower bounds for clustering in moderate dimension

author.name: Alexandra Carpentier, Nicolas Verzelen

entry.summary: Establishes low-degree polynomial lower bounds for clustering Gaussian mixtures in the moderate-dimensional regime (n ≥ dK), addressing a gap between information-theoretic limits and polynomial-time algorithm performance.

entry.title: Plug-and-Play Diffusion Meets ADMM: Dual-Variable Coupling for Robust Medical Image Reconstruction

author.name: Chenhe Du, Xuanyu Tian, Qing Wu, Muyu Liu, Jingyi Yu, Hongjiang Wei, Yuyao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Coupled PnP Diffusion for medical image reconstruction, restoring classical dual variables in ADMM to provide integral feedback that guarantees asymptotic convergence, fixing the memoryless operator flaw in existing plug-and-play diffusion frameworks.

entry.title: SAFARI: A Community-Engaged Approach and Dataset of Stereotype Resources in the Sub-Saharan African Context

author.name: Aishwarya Verma, Laud Ammah, Olivia Nercy Ndlovu Lucas, Andrew Zaldivar, Vinodkumar Prabhakaran, Sunipa Dev

entry.summary: SAFARI introduces a community-engaged multilingual stereotype resource for four sub-Saharan African countries, using telephonic surveys in native languages to capture culturally situated stereotypes for AI safety evaluation.

entry.title: Where Vision Becomes Text: Locating the OCR Routing Bottleneck in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jonathan Steinberg, Oren Gal

entry.summary: Investigates where OCR information enters the language processing stream in VLMs across three architecture families, identifying architecture-specific bottlenecks depending on vision-language integration strategy.

entry.title: Discourse-Aware Dual-Track Streaming Response for Low-Latency Spoken Dialogue Systems

author.name: Siyuan Liu, Jiahui Xu, Feng Jiang, Kuang Wang, Zefeng Zhao, Chu-Ren Huang, Jinghang Gu, Changqing Yin, Haizhou Li

entry.summary: DDTSR proposes a low-latency spoken dialogue architecture enabling listen-while-thinking and speak-while-thinking through discourse connective generation by a small model while a large model performs reasoning in parallel.

entry.title: GIFSplat: Generative Prior-Guided Iterative Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Views

author.name: Tianyu Chen, Wei Xiang, Kang Han, Yu Lu, Di Wu, Gaowen Liu, Ramana Rao Kompella

entry.summary: Introduces GIFSplat, a feed-forward iterative refinement framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse unposed views that maintains second-level inference while injecting generative priors through iterative refinement.

entry.title: Monocular Open Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction for Indoor Scenes

author.name: Changqing Zhou, Yueru Luo, Han Zhang, Zeyu Jiang, Changhao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes monocular open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction for indoor scenes using geometry-only supervision and 3D Language-Embedded Gaussians as an intermediate representation coupling geometry with language-aligned semantics.

entry.title: Asymmetric Idiosyncrasies in Multimodal Models

author.name: Muzi Tao, Chufan Shi, Huijuan Wang, Shengbang Tong, Xuezhe Ma

entry.summary: Studies how captioning model idiosyncrasies propagate through text-to-image pipelines, finding that while text classifiers can identify caption source with 99.7% accuracy, these stylistic signatures largely disappear in generated images.

entry.title: MSJoE: Jointly Evolving MLLM and Sampler for Efficient Long-Form Video Understanding

author.name: Wenhui Tan, Xiaoyi Yu, Jiaze Li, Yijing Chen, Jianzhong Ju, Zhenbo Luo, Ruihua Song, Jian Luan

entry.summary: Presents MSJoE, a framework jointly evolving MLLMs and lightweight keyframe samplers for efficient long-form video understanding, where the sampler learns to select informative frames based on question-relevant queries.

entry.title: Align then Adapt: Rethinking Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning in 4D Perception

author.name: Yiding Sun, Jihua Zhu, Haozhe Cheng, Chaoyi Lu, Zhichuan Yang, Lin Chen, Yaonan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PointATA for parameter-efficient transfer of 3D pre-trained models to 4D perception, using optimal transport theory to align 3D and 4D distributions before adapting.

entry.title: Pixel2Catch: Multi-Agent Sim-to-Real Transfer for Agile Manipulation with a Single RGB Camera

author.name: Seongyong Kim, Junhyeon Cho, Kang-Won Lee, Soo-Chul Lim

entry.summary: Proposes Pixel2Catch, a multi-agent RL framework for catching thrown objects using only a single RGB camera. Decomposes the arm and multi-fingered hand as independent agents with distinct roles for stable high-DoF learning.

entry.title: DySL-VLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference via Dynamic-Static Layer-Skipping for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Zebin Yang, Yijiahao Qi, Tong Xie, Bo Yu, Shaoshan Liu, Meng Li

entry.summary: Proposes DySL-VLA, dynamically skipping VLA model layers based on action importance to reduce computational cost. Distinguishes between critical and routine actions for differentiated processing.

entry.title: How Robust Is Monitoring Against Secret Loyalties?

author.name: Joe Kwon

entry.summary: Analyzes whether AI monitoring is robust against models with secret loyalties. Discusses how many loyalty-relevant actions don't look suspicious and how monitors face the same training vulnerabilities as the systems they oversee.

entry.title: ConstraintBench: Benchmarking LLM Constraint Reasoning on Direct Optimization

author.name: Joseph Tso, Preston Schmittou, Quan Huynh, Jibran Hutchins

entry.summary: Introduces ConstraintBench, evaluating whether LLMs can directly solve constrained optimization problems without a solver across 10 operations research domains, with ground truth verified by Gurobi.

entry.title: CRAG: Can 3D Generative Models Help 3D Assembly?

author.name: Zeyu Jiang, Sihang Li, Siqi Tan, Chenyang Xu, Juexiao Zhang, Julia Galway-Witham, Xue Wang, Scott A. Williams, Radu Iovita, Chen Feng, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CRAG which reformulates 3D assembly as a joint assembly-and-generation problem, where assembly provides structural priors for generation and generation provides holistic shape context that resolves assembly ambiguities.

entry.title: Epistemic Filtering and Collective Hallucination: A Jury Theorem for Confidence-Calibrated Agents

author.name: Jonas Karge

entry.summary: Proposes a jury theorem framework where heterogeneous agents learn to estimate their own reliability and selectively abstain from voting. Proves that selective participation generalizes the asymptotic guarantees of the Condorcet Jury Theorem.

entry.title: CWM: Contrastive World Models for Action Feasibility Learning in Embodied Agent Pipelines

author.name: Chayan Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes Contrastive World Model (CWM), using InfoNCE contrastive objective with hard-mined negatives to train LLMs as action scorers for embodied agents. Pushes valid actions away from invalid ones in scoring space for better action feasibility assessment.

entry.title: Toward Personalized LLM-Powered Agents: Foundations, Evaluation, and Future Directions

author.name: Yue Xu, Qian Chen, Zizhan Ma, Dongrui Liu, Wenxuan Wang, Xiting Wang, Li Xiong, Wenjie Wang

entry.summary: Provides a capability-oriented survey of personalized LLM-powered agents, organized around profile modeling, memory, planning, and action execution. Examines how personalization affects the entire decision pipeline.

entry.title: Agency and Architectural Limits: Why Optimization-Based Systems Cannot Be Norm-Responsive

author.name: Radha Sarma

entry.summary: Argues formally that optimization-based systems (including RLHF-trained LLMs) cannot be genuinely norm-responsive, requiring incommensurability (non-negotiable constraints) and apophatic responsiveness (processing suspension) that optimization architectures cannot provide.

entry.title: AgentDropoutV2: Optimizing Information Flow in Multi-Agent Systems via Test-Time Rectify-or-Reject Pruning

author.name: Yutong Wang, Siyuan Xiong, Xuebo Liu, Wenkang Zhou, Liang Ding, Miao Zhang, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes AgentDropoutV2, a test-time framework that acts as a firewall for multi-agent systems, intercepting and correcting erroneous agent outputs using retrieval-augmented rectification with a failure-driven indicator pool.

entry.title: DS SERVE: A Framework for Efficient and Scalable Neural Retrieval

author.name: Jinjian Liu, Yichuan Wang, Xinxi Lyu, Rulin Shao, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Matei Zaharia, Sewon Min

entry.summary: Presents DS-Serve, a framework that transforms datasets of half a trillion tokens into a high-performance neural retrieval system running on a single node with low latency. Supports inference-time trade-offs between latency, accuracy, and diversity.

entry.title: CryoNet.Refine: A One-step Diffusion Model for Rapid Refinement of Structural Models with Cryo-EM Density Map Restraints

author.name: Fuyao Huang, Xiaozhu Yu, Kui Xu, Qiangfeng Cliff Zhang

entry.summary: Presents CryoNet.Refine, an end-to-end deep learning framework using a one-step diffusion model for rapid molecular structure refinement against cryo-EM density maps. Replaces computationally expensive traditional pipelines like Phenix and Rosetta.

entry.title: Addressing Climate Action Misperceptions with Generative AI

author.name: Miriam Remshard, Yara Kyrychenko, Sander van der Linden, Matthew H. Goldberg, Anthony Leiserowitz, Elena Savoia, Jon Roozenbeek

entry.summary: Studies whether a climate-knowledge-equipped, personalized LLM can correct misperceptions about climate action impacts. In a 1,201-person study, the personalized climate LLM was the only condition that increased both knowledge and willingness to adopt high-impact behaviors.

entry.title: CGSA: Class-Guided Slot-Aware Adaptation for Source-Free Object Detection

author.name: Boyang Dai, Zeng Fan, Zihao Qi, Meng Lou, Yizhou Yu

entry.summary: CGSA introduces Object-Centric Learning into Source-Free Domain Adaptive Object Detection for the first time, using a Hierarchical Slot Awareness module integrated into DETR-based detectors. The method disentangles images into slot representations as visual priors for cross-domain adaptation without source data.

entry.title: Tokenization, Fusion and Decoupling: Bridging the Granularity Mismatch Between Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Siyue Su, Jian Yang, Bo Li, Guanglin Niu

entry.summary: KGT addresses the granularity mismatch between LLMs (which operate on tokens) and knowledge graphs (which operate on entities) by introducing dedicated entity tokens for efficient full-space prediction in knowledge graph completion.

entry.title: MM-NeuroOnco: A Multimodal Benchmark and Instruction Dataset for MRI-Based Brain Tumor Diagnosis

author.name: Feng Guo, Jiaxiang Liu, Yang Li, Qianqian Shi, Mingkun Xu

entry.summary: MM-NeuroOnco introduces a large-scale multimodal benchmark for brain tumor MRI understanding with 24,726 MRI slices and ~200,000 semantically enriched instructions across diverse tumor subtypes, using a multi-model collaborative pipeline for automated annotation.

entry.title: Devling into Adversarial Transferability on Image Classification: Review, Benchmark, and Evaluation

author.name: Xiaosen Wang, Zhijin Ge, Bohan Liu, Zheng Fang, Fengfan Zhou, Ruixuan Zhang, Shaokang Wang, Yuyang Luo

entry.summary: Comprehensive review and benchmark of adversarial transferability on image classification, organizing transfer-based attacks into six categories and proposing standardized evaluation criteria across hundreds of related works.

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning for Efficient High-Resolution GUI Agents

author.name: Zhou Xu, Bowen Zhou, Qi Wang, Shuwen Feng, Jingyu Xiao

entry.summary: GUIPruner is a training-free framework for efficient GUI agent navigation that addresses temporal and spatial redundancy in high-resolution screenshots through adaptive resolution reduction and topology-preserving spatial pruning.

entry.title: SPARTA: Scalable and Principled Benchmark of Tree-Structured Multi-hop QA over Text and Tables

author.name: Sungho Park, Jueun Kim, Wook-Shin Han

entry.summary: SPARTA is an automated framework for generating large-scale Table-Text QA benchmarks with tree-structured multi-hop reasoning, requiring only 25% of the annotation time of HybridQA while supporting complex operations like aggregation and grouping.

entry.title: Orthogonal Weight Modification Enhances Learning Scalability and Convergence Efficiency without Gradient Backpropagation

author.name: Guoqing Ma, Shan Yu

entry.summary: LOCO proposes low-rank cluster orthogonal weight modification as an alternative to backpropagation, finding that orthogonality constraints reduce variance in perturbation-based gradient estimates and improve convergence.

entry.title: OmniZip: Learning a Unified and Lightweight Lossless Compressor for Multi-Modal Data

author.name: Yan Zhao, Zhengxue Cheng, Junxuan Zhang, Dajiang Zhou, Qunshan Gu, Qi Wang, Li Song

entry.summary: Proposes OmniZip, a unified lightweight lossless compressor handling multiple data modalities (image, text, speech, tactile, database, gene sequences) using a single backbone with modality-specific tokenizers.

entry.title: Beyond performance-wise Contribution Evaluation in Federated Learning

author.name: Balazs Pejo

entry.summary: Investigates client contributions to federated learning beyond model accuracy, examining contributions to reliability, resilience, and fairness using Shapley value approximations.

entry.title: KMLP: A Scalable Hybrid Architecture for Web-Scale Tabular Data Modeling

author.name: Mingming Zhang, Pengfei Shi, Zhiqing Xiao, Feng Zhao, Guandong Sun, Yulin Kang, Ruizhe Gao, Ningtao Wang, Xing Fu, Weiqiang Wang, Junbo Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces KMLP, a hybrid architecture combining a shallow KAN front-end with gMLP backbone for web-scale tabular data with billions of instances, automatically learning non-linear feature transformations.

entry.title: Latent Matters: Learning Deep State-Space Models

author.name: Alexej Klushyn, Richard Kurle, Maximilian Soelch, Botond Cseke, Patrick van der Smagt

entry.summary: Shows that training deep state-space models by maximizing ELBO doesn't ensure learning true dynamics, and proposes constrained optimization framework with Extended Kalman VAE (EKVAE) for more accurate dynamics modeling.

entry.title: Learning Physical Operators using Neural Operators

author.name: Vignesh Gopakumar, Ander Gray, Dan Giles, Lorenzo Zanisi, Matt J. Kusner, Timo Betcke, Stanislas Pamela, Marc Peter Deisenroth

entry.summary: Introduces a physics-informed training framework for neural operators that decomposes PDEs via operator splitting, training separate neural operators for nonlinear operators while using fixed convolutions for linear ones.

entry.title: Induction Meets Biology: Mechanisms of Repeat Detection in Protein Language Models

author.name: Gal Kesten-Pomeranz, Yaniv Nikankin, Anja Reusch, Tomer Tsaban, Ora Schueler-Furman, Yonatan Belinkov

entry.summary: Investigates how protein language models detect exact and approximate sequence repeats, finding that approximate repeat detection functionally subsumes exact repeat detection through positional attention heads and biologically informed features.

entry.title: ParamMem: Augmenting Language Agents with Parametric Reflective Memory

author.name: Tianjun Yao, Yongqiang Chen, Yujia Zheng, Pan Li, Zhiqiang Shen, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces ParamMem, a parametric memory module that encodes cross-sample reflection patterns into model parameters, enabling diverse reflection generation to improve language agent reasoning through temperature-controlled sampling.

entry.title: Differentially Private Truncation of Unbounded Data via Public Second Moments

author.name: Zilong Cao, Xuan Bi, Hai Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Public-moment-guided Truncation (PMT) for differential privacy on unbounded data, using second-moment information from public data to transform private data and apply principled truncation, enabling better resistance to DP noise.

entry.title: SubspaceAD: Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Subspace Modeling

author.name: Camile Lendering, Erkut Akdag, Egor Bondarev

entry.summary: SubspaceAD introduces a training-free few-shot anomaly detection method using PCA on frozen DINOv2 features, questioning whether complex memory banks and multi-modal tuning are necessary given strong vision foundation model representations.

entry.title: Assessing Deanonymization Risks with Stylometry-Assisted LLM Agent

author.name: Boyang Zhang, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SALA, a stylometry-assisted LLM agent for assessing deanonymization risks in textual data, combining quantitative stylometric features with LLM reasoning for interpretable authorship attribution.

entry.title: Towards Faithful Industrial RAG: A Reinforced Co-adaptation Framework for Advertising QA

author.name: Wenwei Li, Ming Xu, Tianle Xia, Lingxiang Hu, Yiding Sun, Linfang Shang, Liqun Liu, Peng Shu, Huan Yu, Jie Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforced co-adaptation framework for industrial advertising QA that jointly optimizes graph-aware retrieval (GraphRAG) with evidence-constrained generation to prevent hallucinated URLs and other content that could cause financial/legal harm.

entry.title: SwiftNDC: Fast Neural Depth Correction for High-Fidelity 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Kang Han, Wei Xiang, Lu Yu, Mathew Wyatt, Gaowen Liu, Ramana Rao Kompella

entry.summary: Proposes SwiftNDC for fast 3D reconstruction using neural depth correction fields that produce cross-view consistent depth maps, substantially accelerating 3D Gaussian Splatting for mesh reconstruction.

entry.title: Plug, Play, and Fortify: A Low-Cost Module for Robust Multimodal Image Understanding Models

author.name: Siqi Lu, Wanying Xu, Yongbin Zheng, Wenting Luan, Peng Sun, Jianhang Yao

entry.summary: Proposes a frequency-domain approach to address missing modality robustness in multimodal models. Uses a Frequency Ratio Metric to quantify modality preference and a plug-in module for balanced multimodal learning.

entry.title: Towards Multimodal Domain Generalization with Few Labels

author.name: Hongzhao Li, Hao Dong, Hualei Wan, Shupan Li, Mingliang Xu, Muhammad Haris Khan

entry.summary: Introduces Semi-Supervised Multimodal Domain Generalization (SSMDG) problem and proposes a framework with consensus-driven consistency learning to exploit unlabeled data across domains and modalities.

entry.title: Cytoarchitecture in Words: Weakly Supervised Vision-Language Modeling for Human Brain Microscopy

author.name: Matthew Sutton, Katrin Amunts, Timo Dickscheid, Christian Schiffer

entry.summary: Proposes a weakly supervised vision-language approach for brain microscopy that generates captions from images via label mediation, enabling natural language interfaces for cytoarchitecture analysis.

entry.title: Locally Adaptive Decay Surfaces for High-Speed Face and Landmark Detection with Event Cameras

author.name: Paul Kielty, Timothy Hanley, Peter Corcoran

entry.summary: Introduces Locally Adaptive Decay Surfaces (LADS) for event cameras, where temporal decay at each pixel is modulated by local signal dynamics, resolving the tradeoff between spatial structure preservation and motion sharpness.

entry.title: DyaDiT: A Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer for Socially Favorable Dyadic Gesture Generation

author.name: Yichen Peng, Jyun-Ting Song, Siyeol Jung, Ruofan Liu, Haiyang Liu, Xuangeng Chu, Ruicong Liu, Erwin Wu, Hideki Koike, Kris Kitani

entry.summary: Presents DyaDiT, a multi-modal diffusion transformer for generating contextually appropriate dyadic conversational gestures from audio signals of both speakers, capturing social interaction dynamics.

entry.title: EmbodMocap: In-the-Wild 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction for Embodied Agents

author.name: Wenjia Wang, Liang Pan, Huaijin Pi, Yuke Lou, Xuqian Ren, Yifan Wu, Zhouyingcheng Liao, Lei Yang, Rishabh Dabral, Christian Theobalt, Taku Komura

entry.summary: Presents EmbodMocap, a portable pipeline using two iPhones to capture 4D human-scene reconstruction in everyday environments. Enables metric-scale, scene-consistent motion capture without studio setups for training embodied agents.

entry.title: Towards Long-Form Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding

author.name: Xin Gu, Bing Fan, Jiali Yao, Zhipeng Zhang, Yan Huang, Cheng Han, Heng Fan, Libo Zhang

entry.summary: Explores Long-Form Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding for localizing targets in long videos spanning minutes to hours. Proposes ART-STVG, an autoregressive transformer that processes frames progressively rather than all at once.

entry.title: Metamorphic Testing of Vision-Language Action-Enabled Robots

author.name: Pablo Valle, Sergio Segura, Shaukat Ali, Aitor Arrieta

entry.summary: Proposes metamorphic testing for Vision-Language-Action robot controllers, addressing the test oracle problem through metamorphic relations that assess task execution quality without per-task oracle definitions.

entry.title: Sampling from Constrained Gibbs Measures: with Applications to High-Dimensional Bayesian Inference

author.name: Ruixiao Wang, Xiaohong Chen, Sinho Chewi

entry.summary: Develops theoretical results for sampling from low-temperature Gibbs distributions with constrained support, showing the distribution decomposes into a product of regular and boundary components. Provides non-asymptotic sampling guarantees.

entry.title: Requesting Expert Reasoning: Augmenting LLM Agents with Learned Collaborative Intervention

author.name: Zhiming Wang, Jinwei He, Feng Lu

entry.summary: Introduces AHCE, a framework for on-demand human-AI collaboration where a learned policy treats human experts as interactive reasoning tools. Demonstrates 32% improvement in Minecraft task success on difficult tasks.

entry.title: CXReasonAgent: Evidence-Grounded Diagnostic Reasoning Agent for Chest X-rays

author.name: Hyungyung Lee, Hangyul Yoon, Edward Choi

entry.summary: Presents CXReasonAgent, a diagnostic agent for chest X-rays that integrates LLMs with clinical diagnostic tools for evidence-grounded multi-step reasoning, avoiding costly retraining for new diagnostic tasks.

entry.title: PRIMA: Pre-training with Risk-integrated Image-Metadata Alignment for Medical Diagnosis via LLM

author.name: Yiqing Wang, Chunming He, Ming-Chen Lu, Mercy Pawar, Leslie Niziol, Maria Woodward, Sina Farsiu

entry.summary: Proposes PRIMA, a pre-training framework integrating clinical risk knowledge into multi-modal medical diagnosis. Uses RAG to curate expert knowledge, refines Clinical ModernBERT, and employs DINOv3 with dual-encoder pre-training.

entry.title: Relatron: Automating Relational Machine Learning over Relational Databases

author.name: Zhikai Chen, Han Xie, Jian Zhang, Jiliang Tang, Xiang Song, Huzefa Rangwala

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive study unifying Relational Deep Learning and Deep Feature Synthesis in a shared design space for predictive modeling over relational databases, finding that RDL doesn't consistently outperform DFS.

entry.title: WISER: Wider Search, Deeper Thinking, and Adaptive Fusion for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Tianyue Wang, Leigang Qu, Tianyu Yang, Xiangzhao Hao, Yifan Xu, Haiyun Guo, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes WISER for training-free zero-shot composed image retrieval that unifies text-to-image and image-to-image retrieval paradigms through a retrieve-verify-refine pipeline with adaptive fusion.

entry.title: TriLite: Efficient Weakly Supervised Object Localization with Universal Visual Features and Tri-Region Disentanglement

author.name: Arian Sabaghi, Jos\'e Oramas

entry.summary: Proposes TriLite for weakly supervised object localization using frozen DINOv2 ViT with only ~800K trainable parameters, introducing TriHead that decomposes patches into foreground, background, and boundary regions.

entry.title: DiffBMP: Differentiable Rendering with Bitmap Primitives

author.name: Seongmin Hong, Junghun James Kim, Daehyeop Kim, Insoo Chung, Se Young Chun

entry.summary: Introduces DiffBMP, a differentiable rendering engine for bitmap images using a custom CUDA implementation. Can optimize position, rotation, scale, color, and opacity of thousands of bitmap primitives in under 1 minute on consumer GPUs.

entry.title: A Mathematical Theory of Agency and Intelligence

author.name: Wael Hafez, Chenan Wei, Rodrigo Felipe, Amir Nazeri, Cameron Reid

entry.summary: Proposes a mathematical theory of agency based on 'bipredictability'—the fraction of information shared between observations, actions, and outcomes. Proves it's bounded differently in quantum vs classical systems and relates it to intelligence measurement.

entry.title: FactGuard: Agentic Video Misinformation Detection via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zehao Li, Hongwei Yu, Hao Jiang, Qiang Sheng, Yilong Xu, Baolong Bi, Yang Li, Zhenlong Yuan, Yujun Cai, Zhaoqi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FactGuard, an agentic framework for video misinformation detection that iteratively reasons about task ambiguity and selectively invokes external tools. Uses reinforcement learning to strengthen verification trajectories.

entry.title: On Sample-Efficient Generalized Planning via Learned Transition Models

author.name: Nitin Gupta, Vishal Pallagani, John A. Aydin, Biplav Srivastava

entry.summary: Introduces learned transition models for sample-efficient generalized planning, addressing shortcomings of Transformer-based planners that bypass explicit transition modeling and suffer from state drift in long-horizon settings.

entry.title: ODEBrain: Continuous-Time EEG Graph for Modeling Dynamic Brain Networks

author.name: Haohui Jia, Zheng Chen, Lingwei Zhu, Rikuto Kotoge, Jathurshan Pradeepkumar, Yasuko Matsubara, Jimeng Sun, Yasushi Sakurai, Takashi Matsubara

entry.summary: Proposes ODEBRAIN, using Neural ODEs for continuous-time EEG modeling that integrates spatio-temporal-frequency features into spectral graph nodes, overcoming discretization errors in recurrent approaches.

entry.title: EyeLayer: Integrating Human Attention Patterns into LLM-Based Code Summarization

author.name: Jiahao Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Kevin Leach, Yu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes EyeLayer, a module that incorporates human eye-gaze patterns into LLM-based code summarization using Multimodal Gaussian Mixtures to redistribute token attention based on where developers focus during code reading.

entry.title: Ruyi2 Technical Report

author.name: Huan Song, Shuyu Tian, Junyi Hao, Minxiu Xu, Hongjun An, Yiliang Song, Jiawei Shao, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Presents Ruyi2, an adaptive early-exit LLM architecture built on Megatron-LM with 3D parallel training, achieving 2-3x speedup over Ruyi while matching Qwen3-sized models in performance.

entry.title: TabDLM: Free-Form Tabular Data Generation via Joint Numerical-Language Diffusion

author.name: Donghong Cai, Jiarui Feng, Yanbo Wang, Da Zheng, Yixin Chen, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces TabDLM for generating tabular data containing free-form text alongside numerical/categorical attributes using joint numerical-language diffusion. Addresses the challenge of heterogeneous table generation.

entry.title: Instruction-based Image Editing with Planning, Reasoning, and Generation

author.name: Liya Ji, Chenyang Qi, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: This paper proposes a multimodal model for instruction-based image editing that uses Chain-of-Thought prompts for planning, reasoning, and generation stages. It bridges understanding and generation via a unified multi-modality approach for more complex editing cases.

entry.title: Reinforcing Real-world Service Agents: Balancing Utility and Cost in Task-oriented Dialogue

author.name: Ning Gao, Wei Zhang, Yuqin Dai, Ling Shi, Ziyin Wang, Yujie Wang, Wei He, Jinpeng Wang, Chaozheng Wang

entry.summary: InteractCS-RL reframes task-oriented dialogue as multi-granularity reinforcement learning, balancing empathetic communication with budget-aware decision-making for real-world service agents. It introduces a user-centric interaction framework and cost-aware multi-turn policy optimization.

entry.title: LLMServingSim 2.0: A Unified Simulator for Heterogeneous and Disaggregated LLM Serving Infrastructure

author.name: Jaehong Cho, Hyunmin Choi, Guseul Heo, Jongse Park

entry.summary: LLMServingSim 2.0 is a unified simulator for heterogeneous and disaggregated LLM serving infrastructure, jointly modeling diverse accelerators, near-memory processing, scheduling, data movement, and interconnect behavior.

entry.title: Latent Gaussian Splatting for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking

author.name: Maximilian Luz, Rohit Mohan, Thomas N\"urnberg, Yakov Miron, Daniele Cattaneo, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: LaGS combines camera-based end-to-end tracking with mask-based panoptic occupancy prediction using Gaussian splatting for holistic 4D spatiotemporal scene understanding.

entry.title: Conformalized Neural Networks for Federated Uncertainty Quantification under Dual Heterogeneity

author.name: Quang-Huy Nguyen, Jiaqi Wang, Wei-Shinn Ku

entry.summary: FedWQ-CP provides conformal prediction-based uncertainty quantification for federated learning under both data and model heterogeneity simultaneously, balancing coverage performance with efficiency at global and agent levels.

entry.title: WaveSSM: Multiscale State-Space Models for Non-stationary Signal Attention

author.name: Ruben Solozabal, Velibor Bojkovic, Hilal Alquabeh, Klea Ziu, Kentaro Inui, Martin Takac

entry.summary: WaveSSM constructs state-space models over wavelet frames instead of polynomial bases, providing localized temporal support for signals with transient structure.

entry.title: MolFM-Lite: Multi-Modal Molecular Property Prediction with Conformer Ensemble Attention and Cross-Modal Fusion

author.name: Syed Omer Shah, Mohammed Maqsood Ahmed, Danish Mohiuddin Mohammed, Shahnawaz Alam, Mohd Vahaj ur Rahman

entry.summary: Presents MolFM-Lite, a multi-modal model for molecular property prediction that jointly encodes 1D SELFIES sequences, 2D molecular graphs, and 3D conformer ensembles through cross-attention fusion with Boltzmann-weighted conformer attention.

entry.title: Coarse-to-Fine Learning of Dynamic Causal Structures

author.name: Dezhi Yang, Qiaoyu Tan, Carlotta Domeniconi, Jun Wang, Lizhen Cui, Guoxian Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DyCausal, a framework for learning fully dynamic causal structures in time series where both instantaneous and lagged dependencies evolve over time, using convolutional networks in a coarse-to-fine approach.

entry.title: DP-aware AdaLN-Zero: Taming Conditioning-Induced Heavy-Tailed Gradients in Differentially Private Diffusion

author.name: Tao Huang, Jiayang Meng, Xu Yang, Chen Hou, Hong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DP-aware AdaLN-Zero, a conditioning mechanism for diffusion transformers that limits conditioning-induced heavy-tailed gradients under differential privacy, reducing clipping bias in DP-SGD.

entry.title: Tackling Privacy Heterogeneity in Differentially Private Federated Learning

author.name: Ruichen Xu, Ying-Jun Angela Zhang, Jianwei Huang

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic study of privacy-aware client selection in differentially private federated learning with heterogeneous privacy budgets, developing selection strategies that account for varying noise levels.

entry.title: Enhancing Geometric Perception in VLMs via Translator-Guided Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hao Yu, Shuning Jia, Guanghao Li, Wenhao Jiang, Chun Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes GeoPerceive benchmark and GeoDPO framework to enhance geometric perception in VLMs using a translator-guided RL approach with DSL representations of geometric diagrams.

entry.title: Closing the gap on tabular data with Fourier and Implicit Categorical Features

author.name: Marius Dragoi, Florin Gogianu, Elena Burceanu

entry.summary: Addresses the performance gap between deep learning and tree-based methods on tabular data by identifying features with categorical characteristics using statistical tests and applying Fourier encoding, achieving competitive results.

entry.title: Differentiable Zero-One Loss via Hypersimplex Projections

author.name: Camilo Gomez, Pengyang Wang, Liansheng Tang

entry.summary: Introduces a differentiable approximation to the zero-one loss via projection onto the hypersimplex (Soft-Binary-Argmax), enabling gradient-based optimization with a loss that more closely aligns with classification performance.

entry.title: CrossLLM-Mamba: Multimodal State Space Fusion of LLMs for RNA Interaction Prediction

author.name: Rabeya Tus Sadia, Qiang Ye, Qiang Cheng

entry.summary: CrossLLM-Mamba introduces a framework for RNA interaction prediction that reformulates the problem as state-space alignment, using bidirectional Mamba encoders to enable deep crosstalk between modality-specific embeddings from biological LLMs like ESM-2 and RiNALMo.

entry.title: Unsupervised Continual Learning for Amortized Bayesian Inference

author.name: Aayush Mishra, \v{S}imon Kucharsk\'y, Paul-Christian B\"urkner

entry.summary: Proposes a continual learning framework for amortized Bayesian inference that decouples simulation-based pre-training from unsupervised sequential self-consistency fine-tuning, addressing catastrophic forgetting with episodic replay and adapter-based strategies.

entry.title: Kernel Integrated $R^2$: A Measure of Dependence

author.name: Pouya Roudaki, Shakeel Gavioli-Akilagun, Florian Kalinke, Mona Azadkia, Zolt\'an Szab\'o

entry.summary: Introduces kernel integrated R², a new measure of statistical dependence that extends integrated R² to multivariate, functional, and structured data via reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces while remaining sensitive to tail behavior.

entry.title: FairQuant: Fairness-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Medical Image Classification

author.name: Thomas Woergaard, Raghavendra Selvan

entry.summary: FairQuant introduces fairness-aware mixed-precision quantization for medical image classification, combining group-aware importance analysis with budgeted mixed-precision allocation to consider algorithmic fairness during model compression.

entry.title: Deepfake Word Detection by Next-token Prediction using Fine-tuned Whisper

author.name: Hoan My Tran, Xin Wang, Wanying Ge, Xuechen Liu, Junichi Yamagishi

entry.summary: Fine-tunes Whisper for detecting synthetic (deepfake) words within speech utterances via next-token prediction, while simultaneously performing transcription. Uses partially vocoded utterances to reduce data collection costs. Demonstrates low error rates on in-domain data with some generalization challenges.

entry.title: Pix2Key: Controllable Open-Vocabulary Retrieval with Semantic Decomposition and Self-Supervised Visual Dictionary Learning

author.name: Guoyizhe Wei, Yang Jiao, Nan Xi, Zhishen Huang, Jingjing Meng, Rama Chellappa, Yan Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Pix2Key for composed image retrieval using open-vocabulary visual dictionaries with self-supervised pretraining (V-Dict-AE), enabling intent-aware constraint matching and diversity-aware reranking.

entry.title: ArtPro: Self-Supervised Articulated Object Reconstruction with Adaptive Integration of Mobility Proposals

author.name: Xuelu Li, Zhaonan Wang, Xiaogang Wang, Lei Wu, Manyi Li, Changhe Tu

entry.summary: Proposes ArtPro for self-supervised articulated object reconstruction using adaptive mobility proposals with over-segmentation initialization, addressing local minima problems in differentiable rendering frameworks.

entry.title: SO3UFormer: Learning Intrinsic Spherical Features for Rotation-Robust Panoramic Segmentation

author.name: Qinfeng Zhu, Yunxi Jiang, Lei Fan

entry.summary: Proposes SO3UFormer for rotation-robust panoramic semantic segmentation that learns intrinsic spherical features less sensitive to coordinate frame, addressing performance collapse under 3D reorientations.

entry.title: DMAligner: Enhancing Image Alignment via Diffusion Model Based View Synthesis

author.name: Xinglong Luo, Ao Luo, Zhengning Wang, Yueqi Yang, Chaoyu Feng, Lei Lei, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DMAligner, a diffusion-based framework for image alignment through alignment-oriented view synthesis, replacing flow-based warping to handle occlusions and illumination variations.

entry.title: FLIGHT: Fibonacci Lattice-based Inference for Geometric Heading in real-Time

author.name: David Dirnfeld, Fabien Delattre, Pedro Miraldo, Erik Learned-Miller

entry.summary: Proposes FLIGHT for camera heading estimation using a generalized Hough transform on the unit sphere, providing robust estimation under high noise and outlier conditions from monocular video.

entry.title: UniScale: Unified Scale-Aware 3D Reconstruction for Multi-View Understanding via Prior Injection for Robotic Perception

author.name: Mohammad Mahdavian, Gordon Tan, Binbin Xu, Yuan Ren, Dongfeng Bai, Bingbing Liu

entry.summary: Presents UniScale, a feed-forward network for scale-aware multi-view 3D reconstruction that jointly estimates camera parameters, depth, and metric scale. Designed for robotic navigation with optional geometric prior integration.

entry.title: Retrieve and Segment: Are a Few Examples Enough to Bridge the Supervision Gap in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation?

author.name: Tilemachos Aravanis, Vladan Stojni\'c, Bill Psomas, Nikos Komodakis, Giorgos Tolias

entry.summary: Introduces a few-shot open-vocabulary segmentation setting augmenting text prompts with pixel-annotated support images. Proposes a retrieval-augmented test-time adapter that fuses textual and visual support features.

entry.title: SPARR: Simulation-based Policies with Asymmetric Real-world Residuals for Assembly

author.name: Yijie Guo, Iretiayo Akinola, Lars Johannsmeier, Hugo Hadfield, Abhishek Gupta, Yashraj Narang

entry.summary: Proposes SPARR, combining simulation-trained base policies with real-world residual policies for robotic assembly. The residual policy adapts to sim-to-real gap using asymmetric observations.

entry.title: FIRE: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Financial Intelligence and Reasoning Evaluation

author.name: Xiyuan Zhang, Huihang Wu, Jiayu Guo, Zhenlin Zhang, Yiwei Zhang, Liangyu Huo, Xiaoxiao Ma, Jiansong Wan, Xuewei Jiao, Yi Jing, Jian Xie

entry.summary: Introduces FIRE, a benchmark evaluating LLMs on both theoretical financial knowledge (from qualification exams) and practical business scenarios across 3,000 questions. Provides systematic coverage of financial subdomains and business activities.

entry.title: Knob: A Physics-Inspired Gating Interface for Interpretable and Controllable Neural Dynamics

author.name: Siyu Jiang, Sanshuai Cui, Hui Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes Knob, connecting neural gating dynamics to second-order mechanical systems from control theory. Creates a tunable 'safety valve' using physical parameters (damping ratio, natural frequency) mapped to neural gating.

entry.title: The AI Research Assistant: Promise, Peril, and a Proof of Concept

author.name: Tan Bui-Thanh

entry.summary: Provides empirical evidence through a case study of human-AI collaboration for mathematical research, discovering novel error representations for Hermite quadrature rules. Highlights both capabilities and critical limitations of AI research assistants.

entry.title: RepSPD: Enhancing SPD Manifold Representation in EEGs via Dynamic Graphs

author.name: Haohui Jia, Zheng Chen, Lingwei Zhu, Xu Cao, Yasuko Matsubara, Takashi Matsubara, Yasushi Sakurai

entry.summary: Proposes RepSPD, a geometric deep learning model for EEG decoding that uses cross-attention on Riemannian manifolds to modulate SPD matrices with graph-derived representations, capturing frequency-specific synchronization and brain topology.

entry.title: Enhancing CVRP Solver through LLM-driven Automatic Heuristic Design

author.name: Zhuoliang Xie, Fei Liu, Zhenkun Wang, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Presents AILS-AHD, using LLMs within an evolutionary framework to automatically design and optimize ruin heuristics for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem. Includes an LLM-based acceleration mechanism.

entry.title: Invariant Transformation and Resampling based Epistemic-Uncertainty Reduction

author.name: Sha Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a resampling-based inference method that applies invariant transformations to inputs and aggregates multiple inference outputs to reduce epistemic uncertainty, leveraging partial independence of errors across transformations.

entry.title: Analysis of LLMs Against Prompt Injection and Jailbreak Attacks

author.name: Piyush Jaiswal, Aaditya Pratap, Shreyansh Saraswati, Harsh Kasyap, Somanath Tripathy

entry.summary: Evaluates prompt injection and jailbreak vulnerabilities across multiple open-source LLMs (Phi, Mistral, DeepSeek-R1, Llama 3.2, Qwen, Gemma) using a large manually curated dataset. Finds significant behavioral variation including refusal and silent non-responsiveness.

entry.title: Poisoned Acoustics

author.name: Harrison Dahme

entry.summary: Demonstrates training-data poisoning attacks on acoustic vehicle classification achieving 95.7% attack success rate with only 0.5% label corruption, with zero detectable change in aggregate accuracy. Proves this stealth is structural.

entry.title: From Shallow Bayesian Neural Networks to Gaussian Processes: General Convergence, Identifiability and Scalable Inference

author.name: Gracielle Antunes de Ara\'ujo, Fl\'avio B. Gon\c{c}alves

entry.summary: Studies scaling limits of shallow Bayesian neural networks to Gaussian processes with relaxed convergence assumptions, proposes a convex mixture covariance function, and develops scalable MAP inference. Characterizes identifiability under different input designs.

entry.title: SUPERGLASSES: Benchmarking Vision Language Models as Intelligent Agents for AI Smart Glasses

author.name: Zhuohang Jiang, Xu Yuan, Haohao Qu, Shanru Lin, Kanglong Liu, Wenqi Fan, Qing Li

entry.summary: SUPERGLASSES introduces the first comprehensive VQA benchmark specifically designed for AI smart glasses use cases, built from real-world data. It addresses the gap between standard multimodal datasets and the unique challenges of smart glasses scenarios where identifying the object of interest must precede knowledge retrieval.

entry.title: SoPE: Spherical Coordinate-Based Positional Embedding for Enhancing Spatial Perception of 3D LVLMs

author.name: Guanting Ye, Qiyan Zhao, Wenhao Yu, Liangyu Yuan, Mingkai Li, Xiaofeng Zhang, Jianmin Ji, Yanyong Zhang, Qing Jiang, Ka-Veng Yuen

entry.summary: SoPE introduces a spherical coordinate-based positional embedding for 3D Large Vision-Language Models, addressing limitations of RoPE for encoding 3D spatial structures by mapping point-cloud tokens into spherical coordinates that preserve angular dependencies.

entry.title: Towards Simulating Social Media Users with LLMs: Evaluating the Operational Validity of Conditioned Comment Prediction

author.name: Nils Schwager, Simon M\"unker, Alistair Plum, Achim Rettinger

entry.summary: This study evaluates LLMs as 'silicon subjects' for simulating social media users through Conditioned Comment Prediction, testing open-weight 8B models across English, German, and Luxembourgish scenarios with different prompting and fine-tuning strategies.

entry.title: MoDora: Tree-Based Semi-Structured Document Analysis System

author.name: Bangrui Xu, Qihang Yao, Zirui Tang, Xuanhe Zhou, Yeye He, Shihan Yu, Qianqian Xu, Bin Wang, Guoliang Li, Conghui He, Fan Wu

entry.summary: MoDora is a tree-based system for analyzing semi-structured documents (tables, charts, hierarchical paragraphs) that preserves hierarchical structure for natural language QA, addressing fragmentation issues from OCR-based extraction.

entry.title: Scaling Search Relevance: Augmenting App Store Ranking with LLM-Generated Judgments

author.name: Evangelia Christakopoulou, Vivekkumar Patel, Hemanth Velaga, Sandip Gaikwad

entry.summary: Demonstrates that fine-tuned specialized LLMs significantly outperform larger pre-trained ones for search relevance labeling, using the optimal model to generate millions of textual relevance labels for app store search ranking.

entry.title: BrepCoder: A Unified Multimodal Large Language Model for Multi-task B-rep Reasoning

author.name: Mingi Kim, Yongjun Kim, Jungwoo Kang, Hyungki Kim

entry.summary: Introduces BrepCoder, a multimodal LLM that performs diverse CAD tasks from industry-standard B-rep format inputs by converting CAD modeling sequences into Python-like code and aligning them with B-rep representations.

entry.title: TEFL: Prediction-Residual-Guided Rolling Forecasting for Multi-Horizon Time Series

author.name: Xiannan Huang, Shen Fang, Shuhan Qiu, Chengcheng Yu, Jiayuan Du, Chao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces TEFL, a framework for time series forecasting that explicitly incorporates historical prediction residuals from rolling forecasts into both training and evaluation, capturing persistent biases and unmodeled patterns.

entry.title: Persistent Nonnegative Matrix Factorization via Multi-Scale Graph Regularization

author.name: Jichao Zhang, Ran Miao, Limin Li

entry.summary: Proposes persistent NMF (pNMF) that produces scale-parameterized persistence-aligned embeddings using persistent homology to identify canonical scales where connectivity undergoes qualitative changes.

entry.title: Mitigating Membership Inference in Intermediate Representations via Layer-wise MIA-risk-aware DP-SGD

author.name: Jiayang Meng, Tao Huang, Chen Hou, Guolong Zheng, Hong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Layer-wise MIA-risk-aware DP-SGD that adaptively allocates privacy protection across layers proportional to their membership inference attack vulnerability, rather than using uniform noise.

entry.title: Set-based v.s. Distribution-based Representations of Epistemic Uncertainty: A Comparative Study

author.name: Kaizheng Wang, Yunjia Wang, Fabio Cuzzolin, David Moens, Hans Hallez, Siu Lun Chau

entry.summary: Provides a controlled comparative study of set-based (credal sets) vs distribution-based (Bayesian posterior) representations of epistemic uncertainty in neural networks, constructed from the same predictive model collection.

entry.title: Accelerating Local LLMs on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices via Distributed Prompt Caching

author.name: Hiroki Matsutani, Naoki Matsuda, Naoto Sugiura

entry.summary: Proposes distributed prompt caching across edge devices for accelerating local LLM inference, using Bloom filters to minimize communication overhead for cache lookups over wireless networks.

entry.title: RhythmBERT: A Self-Supervised Language Model Based on Latent Representations of ECG Waveforms for Heart Disease Detection

author.name: Xin Wang, Burcu Ozek, Aruna Mohan, Amirhossein Ravari, Or Zilbershot, Fatemeh Afghah

entry.summary: Proposes RhythmBERT, an ECG language model that tokenizes cardiac P/QRS/T segments into symbolic tokens via autoencoders, treating ECG as a language with rhythm-level semantics rather than generic time series.

entry.title: Takeuchi's Information Criteria as Generalization Measures for DNNs Close to NTK Regime

author.name: Hiroki Naganuma, Taiji Suzuki, Rio Yokota, Masahiro Nomura, Kohta Ishikawa, Ikuro Sato

entry.summary: Studies Takeuchi's Information Criterion as a generalization measure for DNNs, showing it works effectively near the NTK regime through extensive experiments on 5,000+ models across 12 architectures.

entry.title: Mean Estimation from Coarse Data: Characterizations and Efficient Algorithms

author.name: Alkis Kalavasis, Anay Mehrotra, Manolis Zampetakis, Felix Zhou, Ziyu Zhu

entry.summary: Studies Gaussian mean estimation from coarse data (where only the partition set containing each sample is observed), characterizing identifiability conditions and providing efficient algorithms.

entry.title: A Synergistic Approach: Dynamics-AI Ensemble in Tropical Cyclone Forecasting

author.name: Yonghui Li, Wansuo Duan, Hao Li, Wei Han, Han Zhang, Yinuo Li

entry.summary: Develops an AI-driven ensemble forecast system for tropical cyclones using Orthogonal Conditional Nonlinear Optimal Perturbations (O-CNOPs) to generate dynamically optimized perturbations for the FuXi weather model.

entry.title: Towards Dynamic Dense Retrieval with Routing Strategy

author.name: Zhan Su, Fengran Mo, Jinghan Zhang, Yuchen Hui, Jia Ao Sun, Bingbing Wen, Jian-Yun Nie

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Dense Retrieval (DDR), using prefix tuning as modular domain-specific components that can be composed via routing for efficient adaptation to new domains without full model retraining.

entry.title: ManifoldGD: Training-Free Hierarchical Manifold Guidance for Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation

author.name: Ayush Roy, Wei-Yang Alex Lee, Rudrasis Chakraborty, Vishnu Suresh Lokhande

entry.summary: ManifoldGD proposes a training-free diffusion-based dataset distillation framework using hierarchical manifold guidance rather than simple mode-based centroids, improving upon existing score-based distillation methods.

entry.title: Exploring Multimodal LMMs for Online Episodic Memory Question Answering on the Edge

author.name: Giuseppe Lando, Rosario Forte, Antonino Furnari

entry.summary: Investigates running multimodal LLMs on edge devices for real-time episodic memory QA from egocentric video streams. Uses asynchronous descriptor and QA threads to convert video to lightweight textual memory for reasoning.

entry.title: Coded-E2LF: Coded Aperture Light Field Imaging from Events

author.name: Tomoya Tsuchida, Keita Takahashi, Chihiro Tsutake, Toshiaki Fujii, Hajime Nagahara

entry.summary: Proposes Coded-E2LF, a computational imaging method for acquiring 4D light fields using coded aperture and event-only cameras, eliminating the need for intensity images while clarifying the role of black patterns in aperture coding.

entry.title: Beyond Detection: Multi-Scale Hidden-Code for Natural Image Deepfake Recovery and Factual Retrieval

author.name: Yuan-Chih Chen, Chun-Shien Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified hidden-code recovery framework for deepfake image recovery and factual retrieval, encoding semantic and perceptual information via multi-scale vector quantization with conditional Transformer modules.

entry.title: WaterVideoQA: ASV-Centric Perception and Rule-Compliant Reasoning via Multi-Modal Agents

author.name: Runwei Guan, Shaofeng Liang, Ningwei Ouyang, Weichen Fei, Shanliang Yao, Wei Dai, Chenhao Ge, Penglei Sun, Xiaohui Zhu, Tao Huang, Ryan Wen Liu, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Presents WaterVideoQA, the first large-scale Video QA benchmark for autonomous surface vessels across waterway environments with 3,029 clips spanning six waterway categories, bridging visual perception and cognitive reasoning for maritime navigation.

entry.title: WARM-CAT: : Warm-Started Test-Time Comprehensive Knowledge Accumulation for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning

author.name: Xudong Yan, Songhe Feng, Jiaxin Wang, Xin Su, Yi Jin

entry.summary: Proposes WARM-CAT for compositional zero-shot learning, accumulating comprehensive knowledge from unsupervised data at test time to update multimodal prototypes with adaptive update weights.

entry.title: GraspLDP: Towards Generalizable Grasping Policy via Latent Diffusion

author.name: Enda Xiang, Haoxiang Ma, Xinzhu Ma, Zicheng Liu, Di Huang

entry.summary: Proposes GraspLDP, incorporating grasp prior knowledge into a latent diffusion policy framework for robotic manipulation. Improves grasping precision and generalization over existing imitation learning approaches.

entry.title: Towards Intelligible Human-Robot Interaction: An Active Inference Approach to Occluded Pedestrian Scenarios

author.name: Kai Chen, Yuyao Huang, Guang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes an Active Inference framework for autonomous driving that handles occluded pedestrians through belief-driven reasoning, using Rao-Blackwellized Particle Filters and hypothesis injection for modeling pedestrian intentions.

entry.title: Strategic nuclear war twice as likely to occur by accident than by AI decisions according to new study

author.name: kromem

entry.summary: Critiques a study on AI in nuclear crisis simulations, focusing on the 'accident' mechanic design. Shows the study's finding that nuclear war is twice as likely from accidents than AI decisions is an artifact of experimental design.

entry.title: Vibe Researching as Wolf Coming: Can AI Agents with Skills Replace or Augment Social Scientists?

author.name: Yongjun Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces 'vibe researching' as an AI-era concept parallel to vibe coding, using a 21-skill plugin for Claude Code that covers the full research pipeline. Develops a cognitive task framework classifying research activities by AI replaceability.

entry.title: MobilityBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Route-Planning Agents in Real-World Mobility Scenarios

author.name: Zhiheng Song, Jingshuai Zhang, Chuan Qin, Chao Wang, Chao Chen, Longfei Xu, Kaikui Liu, Xiangxiang Chu, Hengshu Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces MobilityBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based route-planning agents using real anonymized queries from Amap, covering diverse routing intents across multiple cities with reproducible evaluation.

entry.title: PATRA: Pattern-Aware Alignment and Balanced Reasoning for Time Series Question Answering

author.name: Junkai Lu, Peng Chen, Xingjian Wu, Yang Shu, Chenjuan Guo, Christian S. Jensen, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PATRA for time series question answering, using pattern-aware alignment to extract trends and seasonalities and task-aware balanced training to prevent simpler objectives from dominating learning.

entry.title: SC-Arena: A Natural Language Benchmark for Single-Cell Reasoning with Knowledge-Augmented Evaluation

author.name: Jiahao Zhao, Feng Jiang, Shaowei Qin, Zhonghui Zhang, Junhao Liu, Guibing Guo, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Min Yang

entry.summary: Introduces SC-ARENA, a natural language evaluation framework for single-cell foundation models, formalizing a virtual cell abstraction that unifies evaluation targets for intrinsic attributes and gene-level interactions.

entry.title: Survey on Neural Routing Solvers

author.name: Yunpeng Ba, Xi Lin, Changliang Zhou, Ruihao Zheng, Zhenkun Wang, Xinyan Liang, Zhichao Lu, Jianyong Sun, Yuhua Qian, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of neural routing solvers for vehicle routing problems, introducing a taxonomy based on heuristic principles and a generalization-focused evaluation pipeline addressing limitations of conventional benchmarking.

entry.title: SmartChunk Retrieval: Query-Aware Chunk Compression with Planning for Efficient Document RAG

author.name: Xuechen Zhang, Koustava Goswami, Samet Oymak, Jiasi Chen, Nedim Lipka

entry.summary: Proposes SmartChunk, a query-adaptive chunking framework for RAG that replaces static fixed-size chunking with dynamic, query-aware chunk compression and planning for long-document QA. Addresses sensitivity to chunk size and noise from irrelevant chunks.

entry.title: Learning to reconstruct from saturated data: audio declipping and high-dynamic range imaging

author.name: Victor Sechaud, Laurent Jacques, Patrice Abry, Juli\'an Tachella

entry.summary: Extends self-supervised learning to the non-linear inverse problem of audio declipping and HDR imaging by assuming approximate amplitude invariance. Provides sufficient conditions for learning reconstruction from saturated signals alone.

entry.title: Early Risk Stratification of Dosing Errors in Clinical Trials Using Machine Learning

author.name: F\'elicien H\^eche, Sohrab Ferdowsi, Anthony Yazdani, Sara Sansaloni-Pastor, Douglas Teodoro

entry.summary: Develops an ML framework for early risk stratification of clinical trials for dosing errors using ClinicalTrials.gov data (42,112 trials). Evaluates XGBoost on structured features and ClinicalModernBERT on text data.

entry.title: GetBatch: Distributed Multi-Object Retrieval for ML Data Loading

author.name: Alex Aizman, Abhishek Gaikwad, Piotr \.Zelasko

entry.summary: Introduces GetBatch, a new object store API that makes batch retrieval a first-class operation for ML data loading. Achieves up to 15x throughput improvement for small objects and reduces tail latency significantly.

entry.title: ECHO: Encoding Communities via High-order Operators

author.name: Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Introduces ECHO, a scalable self-supervised architecture for community detection that reframes the problem as adaptive multi-scale diffusion with a topology-aware router that analyzes structural properties to route graph processing.

entry.title: SignVLA: A Gloss-Free Vision-Language-Action Framework for Real-Time Sign Language-Guided Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xinyu Tan, Ningwei Bai, Harry Gardener, Zhengyang Zhong, Luoyu Zhang, Liuhaichen Yang, Zhekai Duan, Monkgogi Galeitsiwe, Zezhi Tang

entry.summary: Presents SignVLA, claimed as the first sign language-driven Vision-Language-Action framework for robot manipulation, using a gloss-free paradigm that directly maps visual sign gestures to semantic instructions for inclusive human-robot interaction.

entry.title: Autoregressive Visual Decoding from EEG Signals

author.name: Sicheng Dai, Hongwang Xiao, Shan Yu, Qiwei Ye

entry.summary: Presents AVDE, a lightweight autoregressive framework for visual decoding from EEG signals, using pre-trained EEG models for efficient brain-computer interface applications.

entry.title: AMLRIS: Alignment-aware Masked Learning for Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Tongfei Chen, Shuo Yang, Yuguang Yang, Linlin Yang, Runtang Guo, Changbai Li, He Long, Chunyu Xie, Dawei Leng, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: AMLRIS introduces Alignment-Aware Masked Learning for referring image segmentation, estimating pixel-level vision-language alignment to filter poorly aligned regions during training. Achieves SOTA on RefCOCO datasets.

entry.title: QSIM: Mitigating Overestimation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Action Similarity Weighted Q-Learning

author.name: Yuanjun Li, Bin Zhang, Hao Chen, Zhouyang Jiang, Dapeng Li, Zhiwei Xu

entry.summary: QSIM addresses Q-value overestimation in cooperative multi-agent RL by reconstructing TD targets using action similarity weights over a structured near-greedy joint action space, avoiding the max operator's systematic bias.

entry.title: pMoE: Prompting Diverse Experts Together Wins More in Visual Adaptation

author.name: Shentong Mo, Xufang Luo, Dongsheng Li

entry.summary: pMoE proposes a Mixture-of-Experts prompt tuning method that combines knowledge from multiple expert domains through specialized prompt tokens and a learnable dispatcher for visual adaptation tasks.

entry.title: SeeThrough3D: Occlusion Aware 3D Control in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Vaibhav Agrawal, Rishubh Parihar, Pradhaan Bhat, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla, R. Venkatesh Babu

entry.summary: SeeThrough3D explicitly models occlusions in 3D layout-conditioned image generation using translucent 3D boxes where transparency encodes hidden regions, enabling depth-consistent geometry.

entry.title: Disentangling Shared and Target-Enriched Topics via Background-Contrastive Non-negative Matrix Factorization

author.name: Yixuan Li, Archer Y. Yang, Yue Li

entry.summary: Introduces background contrastive NMF (bcNMF) that extracts target-enriched latent topics by jointly factorizing target and background datasets, enabling condition-specific signal recovery from high-dimensional biological data.

entry.title: $\phi$-DPO: Fairness Direct Preference Optimization Approach to Continual Learning in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Thanh-Dat Truong, Huu-Thien Tran, Jackson Cothren, Bhiksha Raj, Khoa Luu

entry.summary: Presents FaiDPO, a framework combining Direct Preference Optimization with fairness considerations for continual learning in large multimodal models, addressing bias from imbalanced data distributions.

entry.title: Hypernetwork-based approach for grid-independent functional data clustering

author.name: Anirudh Thatipelli, Ali Siahkoohi

entry.summary: Introduces a hypernetwork-based framework for grid-independent functional data clustering that maps discretized observations at arbitrary resolutions into fixed-dimensional embeddings via implicit neural representations.

entry.title: Physics-informed neural particle flow for the Bayesian update step

author.name: Domonkos Csuzdi, Tam\'as B\'ecsi, Oliv\'er T\"or\H{o}

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed neural particle flow for Bayesian updates that couples log-homotopy density transport with the continuity equation, creating an amortized inference framework for high-dimensional nonlinear estimation.

entry.title: Physics Informed Viscous Value Representations

author.name: Hrishikesh Viswanath, Juanwu Lu, S. Talha Bukhari, Damon Conover, Ziran Wang, Aniket Bera

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed regularization for offline goal-conditioned RL derived from the viscosity solution of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation, addressing ill-posedness of Eikonal equation-based approaches.

entry.title: Solving stiff dark matter equations via Jacobian Normalization with Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: M. P. Bento, H. B. C\^amara, J. R. Rocha, J. F. Seabra

entry.summary: Proposes Jacobian normalization for PINNs to handle stiff differential equations, applying it to Boltzmann equations governing WIMP dark matter with improved accuracy over attention-based methods.

entry.title: A Fast and Practical Column Generation Approach for Identifying Carcinogenic Multi-Hit Gene Combinations

author.name: Rick S. H. Willemsen, Tenindra Abeywickrama, Ramu Anandakrishnan

entry.summary: Formalizes the Multi-Hit Cancer Driver Set Cover Problem for identifying carcinogenic gene mutation combinations, and presents constraint programming and mixed integer programming formulations that match exhaustive search performance without requiring supercomputing.

entry.title: DPSQL+: A Differentially Private SQL Library with a Minimum Frequency Rule

author.name: Tomoya Matsumoto, Shokichi Takakura, Shun Takagi, Satoshi Hasegawa

entry.summary: DPSQL+ is a privacy-preserving SQL library that simultaneously enforces differential privacy and minimum frequency rules, combining two important governance requirements in a modular architecture for practical data analysis.

entry.title: Regular Fourier Features for Nonstationary Gaussian Processes

author.name: Arsalan Jawaid, Abdullah Karatas, J\"org Seewig

entry.summary: Proposes regular Fourier features for simulating nonstationary (harmonizable) Gaussian processes by directly discretizing the spectral representation, avoiding the overly restrictive requirement that spectral densities be probability measures.

entry.title: Sequential Regression for Continuous Value Prediction using Residual Quantization

author.name: Runpeng Cui, Zhipeng Sun, Chi Lu, Peng Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes residual quantization-based sequential regression for continuous value prediction in recommendation systems, handling complex long-tailed distributions without rigid parametric assumptions.

entry.title: Effective QA-driven Annotation of Predicate-Argument Relations Across Languages

author.name: Jonathan Davidov, Aviv Slobodkin, Shmuel Tomi Klein, Reut Tsarfaty, Ido Dagan, Ayal Klein

entry.summary: Presents a cross-linguistic projection approach for extending QA-SRL semantic role labeling to new languages using constrained translation and word-alignment from English parsers.

entry.title: CiteLLM: An Agentic Platform for Trustworthy Scientific Reference Discovery

author.name: Mengze Hong, Di Jiang, Chen Jason Zhang, Zichang Guo, Yawen Li, Jun Chen, Shaobo Cui, Zhiyang Su

entry.summary: CiteLLM is an agentic platform for scientific reference discovery embedded in LaTeX editors, designed to ground author claims with verified citations while ensuring local processing for privacy.

entry.title: MammoWise: Multi-Model Local RAG Pipeline for Mammography Report Generation

author.name: Raiyan Jahangir, Nafiz Imtiaz Khan, Amritanand Sudheerkumar, Vladimir Filkov

entry.summary: Presents MammoWise, a local multi-model RAG pipeline that transforms open-source VLMs into mammogram report generators, supporting zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting with optional multimodal RAG, all running locally for privacy.

entry.title: IRSDE-Despeckle: A Physics-Grounded Diffusion Model for Generalizable Ultrasound Despeckling

author.name: Shuoqi Chen, Yujia Wu, Geoffrey P. Luke

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-grounded diffusion model for ultrasound despeckling built on the Image Restoration SDE framework, trained on paired data simulated from MRI using ultrasound simulation tools.

entry.title: SpectralMamba-UNet: Frequency-Disentangled State Space Modeling for Texture-Structure Consistent Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Fuhao Zhang, Lei Liu, Jialin Zhang, Ya-Nan Zhang, Nan Mu

entry.summary: Proposes SpectralMamba-UNet for medical image segmentation, using frequency-domain decomposition to separately model structural (low-frequency) and textural (high-frequency) features with Mamba-based state space models.

entry.title: From Calibration to Refinement: Seeking Certainty via Probabilistic Evidence Propagation for Noisy-Label Person Re-Identification

author.name: Xin Yuan, Zhiyong Zhang, Xin Xu, Zheng Wang, Chia-Wen Lin

entry.summary: Proposes CARE method for noisy-label person re-identification, using calibration-to-refinement with evidential learning to address softmax overconfidence and improve hard positive selection.

entry.title: No Labels, No Look-Ahead: Unsupervised Online Video Stabilization with Classical Priors

author.name: Tao Liu, Gang Wan, Kan Ren, Shibo Wen

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised online video stabilization framework using classical pipeline stages with multithreaded buffering, introducing a new multimodal UAV aerial video dataset for evaluation.

entry.title: Multidimensional Task Learning: A Unified Tensor Framework for Computer Vision Tasks

author.name: Alaa El Ichi, Khalide Jbilou

entry.summary: Introduces Multidimensional Task Learning using Generalized Einstein MLPs that operate directly on tensors via the Einstein product. Argues this unifies classification, segmentation, and detection under one mathematical framework without flattening.

entry.title: SCOPE: Skeleton Graph-Based Computation-Efficient Framework for Autonomous UAV Exploration

author.name: Kai Li, Shengtao Zheng, Linkun Xiu, Yuze Sheng, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Dongyue Huang, Xinlei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE, a skeleton graph-based framework for autonomous UAV exploration that incrementally builds spatial graphs with hierarchical on-demand planning. Achieves efficient exploration on resource-constrained edge devices.

entry.title: InCoM: Intent-Driven Perception and Structured Coordination for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Jiahao Liu, Cui Wenbo, Haoran Li, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes InCoM for whole-body mobile manipulation, using intent-driven perception to dynamically reweight multi-scale features and structured coordination to decouple base and arm control.

entry.title: Interface-Aware Trajectory Reconstruction of Limited Demonstrations for Robot Learning

author.name: Demiana R. Barsoum, Mahdieh Nejati Javaremi, Larisa Y. C. Loke, Brenna D. Argall

entry.summary: Presents a trajectory reconstruction algorithm for assistive robotics that lifts interface-limited demonstrations into the robot's full control space, reasoning about task, environment, and interface constraints.

entry.title: Improving Internal Model Principle

author.name: mremre

entry.summary: Proposes improvements to the Abstract Internal Model Principle for application to AI agents, funded by ARIA. Aims to extend formal results about world models in agents to a wider class of systems.

entry.title: Announcing ControlConf 2026

author.name: Buck

entry.summary: Announces ControlConf 2026 (April 18-19, Berkeley), a conference on AI control—safeguards that work even when AI models actively try to undermine them. Notes that since the previous ControlConf in Feb 2025, AI agents have improved substantially and control techniques are becoming load-bearing for real deployments, with AI companies starting to build initial control measures.

entry.title: A Framework for Assessing AI Agent Decisions and Outcomes in AutoML Pipelines

author.name: Gaoyuan Du, Amit Ahlawat, Xiaoyang Liu, Jing Wu

entry.summary: Proposes an Evaluation Agent framework for assessing intermediate decisions in AutoML pipelines, going beyond outcome-centric evaluation to decision-level assessment across validity, rationality, efficiency, and robustness dimensions.

entry.title: DeepPresenter: Environment-Grounded Reflection for Agentic Presentation Generation

author.name: Hao Zheng, Guozhao Mo, Xinru Yan, Qianhao Yuan, Wenkai Zhang, Xuanang Chen, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Xianpei Han, Le Sun

entry.summary: Introduces DeepPresenter, an agentic framework for presentation generation that autonomously plans, renders, and revises slides using environment-grounded reflection rather than self-reflection over internal signals.

entry.title: SPM-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Scanning Probe Microscopy

author.name: Peiyao Xiao, Xiaogang Li, Chengliang Xu, Jiayi Wang, Ben Wang, Zichao Chen, Zeyu Wang, Kejun Yu, Yueqian Chen, Xulin Liu, Wende Xiao, Bing Zhao, Hu Wei
