entry.summary: Introduces Persona4Rec, a recommendation framework that performs expensive LLM reasoning offline to construct persona representations of items, enabling lightweight real-time inference.

entry.title: VecGlypher: Unified Vector Glyph Generation with Language Models

author.name: Xiaoke Huang, Bhavul Gauri, Kam Woh Ng, Tony Ng, Mengmeng Xu, Zhiheng Liu, Weiming Ren, Zhaochong An, Zijian Zhou, Haonan Qiu, Yuyin Zhou, Sen He, Ziheng Wang, Tao Xiang, Xiao Han

entry.summary: Introduces VecGlypher, a multimodal language model that generates high-fidelity vector glyphs (SVG paths) directly from text descriptions or image exemplars, avoiding raster intermediates.

entry.title: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Discovery in Geoscientific Data Archives

author.name: Dmitrii Pantiukhin, Ivan Kuznetsov, Boris Shapkin, Antonia Anna Jost, Thomas Jung, Nikolay Koldunov

entry.summary: Introduces PANGAEA-GPT, a hierarchical multi-agent LLM system for autonomous discovery and analysis in Earth science data archives. Uses a Supervisor-Worker topology with sandboxed code execution and self-correction to address underutilization of geoscientific datasets.

entry.title: Reasoning-Based Personalized Generation for Users with Sparse Data

author.name: Bo Ni, Branislav Kveton, Samyadeep Basu, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Leyao Wang, Franck Dernoncourt, Sungchul Kim, Seunghyun Yoon, Zichao Wang, Ruiyi Zhang, Puneet Mathur, Jihyung Kil, Jiuxiang Gu, Nedim Lipka, Yu Wang, Ryan A. Rossi, Tyler Derr

entry.summary: Introduces GraSPer, a framework for personalized text generation with sparse user history. Uses graph-based reasoning to augment user context by predicting likely future interactions, then generates personalized text with reasoning alignment.

entry.title: MrBERT: Modern Multilingual Encoders via Vocabulary, Domain, and Dimensional Adaptation

author.name: Daniel Tamayo, I\~naki Lacunza, Paula Rivera-Hidalgo, Severino Da Dalt, Javier Aula-Blasco, Aitor Gonzalez-Agirre, Marta Villegas

entry.summary: Introduces MrBERT, a family of 150M-300M parameter encoders built on ModernBERT, pre-trained on 35 languages and code. Achieves SOTA on Catalan/Spanish tasks with Matryoshka Representation Learning for flexible vector sizing.

entry.title: UniWhisper: Efficient Continual Multi-task Training for Robust Universal Audio Representation

author.name: Yuxuan Chen, Peize He, Haoyuan Xu, Junzi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes UniWhisper, a continual multi-task training framework that creates a universal audio encoder by casting heterogeneous audio tasks into a unified instruction-answer format. Achieves strong performance across speech, environmental sound, and music on 20 tasks.

entry.title: DualWeaver: Synergistic Feature Weaving Surrogates for Multivariate Forecasting with Univariate Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Jinpeng Li, Zhongyi Pei, Huaze Xue, Bojian Zheng, Chen Wang, Jianmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DualWeaver, a framework adapting univariate time series foundation models for multivariate forecasting using learnable surrogate series. Symmetric structure enables parameter-free reconstruction of predictions.

entry.title: Recovered in Translation: Efficient Pipeline for Automated Translation of Benchmarks and Datasets

author.name: Hanna Yukhymenko, Anton Alexandrov, Martin Vechev

entry.summary: Presents an automated framework for high-quality translation of benchmarks and datasets using test-time compute scaling strategies (USI and T-RANK). Addresses semantic drift and context loss in translated benchmarks.

entry.title: SymTorch: A Framework for Symbolic Distillation of Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Elizabeth S. Z. Tan, Adil Soubki, Miles Cranmer

entry.summary: Introduces SymTorch, a library that automates symbolic distillation of neural network components into interpretable mathematical expressions using PySR. Handles engineering challenges of GPU-CPU transfer, caching, and serialization.

entry.title: Efficient Opportunistic Approachability

author.name: Teodor Vanislavov Marinov, Mehryar Mohri, Princewill Okoroafor, Jon Schneider, Julian Zimmert

entry.summary: Presents an efficient algorithm for opportunistic approachability that avoids the exponential-time calibration requirements of previous methods. Achieves rates scaling as T^{-1/2} independent of dimension.

entry.title: Generative Bayesian Computation as a Scalable Alternative to Gaussian Process Surrogates

author.name: Nick Polson, Vadim Sokolov

entry.summary: Proposes Generative Bayesian Computation using Implicit Quantile Networks as a scalable alternative to Gaussian Process surrogates. Learns full conditional quantile functions with linear scaling, improving on GP's cubic cost.

entry.title: The Error of Deep Operator Networks Is the Sum of Its Parts: Branch-Trunk and Mode Error Decompositions

author.name: Alexander Heinlein, Johannes Taraz

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of DeepONet approximation error, showing it decomposes into branch and trunk network components, with the branch network dominating when internal dimension is sufficiently large. Offers insights for improving operator learning architectures.

entry.title: Efficient Uncoupled Learning Dynamics with $\tilde{O}\!\left(T^{-1/4}\right)$ Last-Iterate Convergence in Bilinear Saddle-Point Problems over Convex Sets under Bandit Feedback

author.name: Arnab Maiti, Claire Jie Zhang, Kevin Jamieson, Jamie Heather Morgenstern, Ioannis Panageas, Lillian J. Ratliff

entry.summary: Designs an uncoupled learning algorithm achieving last-iterate convergence to Nash equilibrium at rate Õ(T^{-1/4}) for bilinear saddle-point problems over convex sets under bandit feedback.

entry.title: Trie-Aware Transformers for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Zhenxiang Xu, Jiawei Chen, Sirui Chen, Yong He, Jieyu Yang, Chuan Yuan, Ke Ding, Can Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TrieRec, a trie-aware generative recommendation model that respects the hierarchical prefix tree structure induced by item tokenization, rather than flattening tokens into linear streams.

entry.title: Learning Quantum Data Distribution via Chaotic Quantum Diffusion Model

author.name: Quoc Hoan Tran, Koki Chinzei, Yasuhiro Endo, Hirotaka Oshima

entry.summary: Proposes a chaotic quantum diffusion model using Hamiltonian time evolution for quantum data generation, providing a hardware-compatible alternative to circuit-based approaches for quantum denoising diffusion.

entry.title: Evaluating the Usage of African-American Vernacular English in Large Language Models

author.name: Deja Dunlap, R. Thomas McCoy

entry.summary: Analyzes how accurately LLMs represent African American Vernacular English (AAVE) by comparing model-generated text to human usage patterns from corpora, finding substantial differences.

entry.title: RADAR: Reasoning as Discrimination with Aligned Representations for LLM-based Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Bo Xue, Yuan Jin, Luoyi Fu, Jiaxin Ding, Xinbing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes RADAR, which reformulates knowledge graph reasoning from generative pattern matching to discriminative relational reasoning using reinforcement learning, operating directly in representation space for better out-of-distribution generalization.

entry.title: Exploring Vision-Language Models for Open-Vocabulary Zero-Shot Action Segmentation

author.name: Asim Unmesh, Kaki Ramesh, Mayank Patel, Rahul Jain, Karthik Ramani

entry.summary: Explores open-vocabulary zero-shot temporal action segmentation using VLMs with a training-free pipeline combining frame-action embedding similarity and temporal segmentation, plus a new benchmark (OVTAS-Bench).

entry.title: Unified Unsupervised and Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection by Semantic Pseudo-Labeling and Prototype Learning

author.name: Yushen He

entry.summary: Proposes SPL, a unified framework for both unsupervised and sparsely-supervised 3D object detection that generates high-quality pseudo-labels by integrating image semantics, point cloud geometry, and temporal cues.

entry.title: Easy3E: Feed-Forward 3D Asset Editing via Rectified Voxel Flow

author.name: Shimin Hu, Yuanyi Wei, Fei Zha, Yudong Guo, Juyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Easy3E, a feed-forward 3D editing framework using Voxel FlowEdit for globally consistent deformation and normal-guided detail restoration, enabling single-view 3D model editing without iterative optimization.

entry.title: Generalizing Visual Geometry Priors to Sparse Gaussian Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Changqing Zhou, Yueru Luo, Changhao Chen

entry.summary: Presents GPOcc, a framework leveraging visual geometry models (VGGT) for 3D occupancy prediction by generalizing surface-level geometry priors to volumetric interior reasoning using sparse Gaussian representations.

entry.title: TranX-Adapter: Bridging Artifacts and Semantics within MLLMs for Robust AI-generated Image Detection

author.name: Wenbin Wang, Yuge Huang, Jianqing Xu, Yue Yu, Jiangtao Yan, Shouhong Ding, Pan Zhou, Yong Luo

entry.summary: Proposes TranX-Adapter, a lightweight fusion adapter for detecting AI-generated images by integrating texture-level artifact features with semantic features in MLLMs, addressing attention dilution caused by high intra-feature similarity.

entry.title: XStreamVGGT: Extremely Memory-Efficient Streaming Vision Geometry Grounded Transformer with KV Cache Compression

author.name: Zunhai Su, Weihao Ye, Hansen Feng, Keyu Fan, Jing Zhang, Dahai Yu, Zhengwu Liu, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes XStreamVGGT, a tuning-free KV cache compression approach for streaming 3D reconstruction that combines pruning and quantization to address unbounded memory growth in long-video inputs.

entry.title: Global-Aware Edge Prioritization for Pose Graph Initialization

author.name: Tong Wei, Giorgos Tolias, Jiri Matas, Daniel Barath

entry.summary: Proposes a GNN-based approach for pose graph initialization in Structure-from-Motion that prioritizes edges based on global consistency rather than treating image pairs independently. Uses SfM-derived supervision and multi-minimal-spanning-tree construction.

entry.title: RobustVisRAG: Causality-Aware Vision-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation under Visual Degradations

author.name: I-Hsiang Chen, Yu-Wei Liu, Tse-Yu Wu, Yu-Chien Chiang, Jen-Chien Yang, Wei-Ting Chen

entry.summary: Introduces RobustVisRAG, a causality-guided dual-path framework for improving vision-based retrieval-augmented generation under visual degradations like blur, noise, and low light. Separates degradation signals from semantic content using causal reasoning.

entry.title: CoLoGen: Progressive Learning of Concept`-`Localization Duality for Unified Image Generation

author.name: YuXin Song, Yu Lu, Haoyuan Sun, Huanjin Yao, Fanglong Liu, Yifan Sun, Haocheng Feng, Hang Zhou, Jingdong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CoLoGen, a unified diffusion framework for conditional image generation that reconciles concept understanding and localization cues through a staged curriculum learning approach.

entry.title: Dream-SLAM: Dreaming the Unseen for Active SLAM in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Xiangqi Meng, Pengxu Hou, Zhenjun Zhao, Javier Civera, Daniel Cremers, Hesheng Wang, Haoang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Dream-SLAM, a monocular active SLAM method that 'dreams' unseen cross-spatio-temporal images and semantically plausible structures for long-term planning in dynamic environments.

entry.title: Lumosaic: Hyperspectral Video via Active Illumination and Coded-Exposure Pixels

author.name: Dhruv Verma, Andrew Qiu, Roberto Rangel, Ayandev Barman, Hao Yang, Chenjia Hu, Fengqi Zhang, Roman Genov, David B. Lindell, Kiriakos N. Kutulakos, Alex Mariakakis

entry.summary: Presents Lumosaic, a compact active hyperspectral video system combining narrowband LEDs with coded-exposure-pixel cameras for real-time 31-channel hyperspectral video capture at 400-700nm with motion robustness.

entry.title: Learning Deformable Object Manipulation Using Task-Level Iterative Learning Control

author.name: Krishna Suresh, Chris Atkeson

entry.summary: Introduces Task-Level Iterative Learning Control for dynamic manipulation of deformable objects, demonstrated on a flying knot task. Learns from a single human demonstration without large datasets or massive simulation.

entry.title: DAGS-SLAM: Dynamic-Aware 3DGS SLAM via Spatiotemporal Motion Probability and Uncertainty-Aware Scheduling

author.name: Li Zhang, Yu-An Liu, Xijia Jiang, Conghao Huang, Danyang Li, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Presents DAGS-SLAM, a dynamic-aware 3DGS SLAM system using spatiotemporal motion probability per Gaussian and uncertainty-aware semantic scheduling, avoiding expensive per-frame optical flow and segmentation.

entry.title: Prosaic Continual Learning

author.name: HunterJay

entry.summary: Argues that practical continual learning can be achieved without theoretical breakthroughs in weight updates by combining long context windows, high-quality summaries, and detailed documentation. The approach essentially substitutes in-context memory for weight updates, using RL to train models to create and retrieve useful summaries of past experience.

entry.title: Compact Circulant Layers with Spectral Priors

author.name: Joseph Margaryan, Thomas Hamelryck

entry.summary: Introduces compact spectral circulant and BCCB layers parameterized in frequency domain, enabling structured variational inference, exact spectral norm computation, and Lipschitz bounds for resource-constrained deployments.

entry.title: Global Sequential Testing for Multi-Stream Auditing

author.name: Beepul Bharti, Ambar Pal, Jeremias Sulam

entry.summary: Proposes new sequential hypothesis tests for multi-stream auditing of ML systems, improving upon Bonferroni-corrected approaches with different trade-offs for sparse vs. dense alternatives.

entry.title: Private and Robust Contribution Evaluation in Federated Learning

author.name: Delio Jaramillo Velez, Gergely Biczok, Alexandre Graell i Amat, Johan Ostman, Balazs Pejo

entry.summary: Introduces marginal-difference contribution scores compatible with secure aggregation in federated learning, enabling fair contribution evaluation without compromising privacy protections.

entry.title: Neural solver for Wasserstein Geodesics and optimal transport dynamics

author.name: Hailiang Liu, Yan-Han Chen

entry.summary: Introduces a neural solver for computing Wasserstein geodesics using the dynamical formulation of optimal transport, recasting constrained optimization as a minimax problem with deep neural networks.

entry.title: ConformalHDC: Uncertainty-Aware Hyperdimensional Computing with Application to Neural Decoding

author.name: Ziyi Liang, Hamed Poursiami, Zhishun Yang, Keiland Cooper, Akhilesh Jaiswal, Maryam Parsa, Norbert Fortin, Babak Shahbaba

entry.summary: Introduces ConformalHDC, combining conformal prediction's statistical guarantees with Hyperdimensional Computing's efficiency, applied to neural decoding. Provides set-valued formulations with coverage guarantees.

entry.title: SEF-MAP: Subspace-Decomposed Expert Fusion for Robust Multimodal HD Map Prediction

author.name: Haoxiang Fu, Lingfeng Zhang, Hao Li, Ruibing Hu, Zhengrong Li, Guanjing Liu, Zimu Tan, Long Chen, Hangjun Ye, Xiaoshuai Hao

entry.summary: Proposes SEF-MAP, a subspace-expert fusion framework for HD map prediction that disentangles BEV features into four semantic subspaces (LiDAR-private, Image-private, Shared, Interaction) with uncertainty-aware gating.

entry.title: CADC: Content Adaptive Diffusion-Based Generative Image Compression

author.name: Xihua Sheng, Lingyu Zhu, Tianyu Zhang, Dong Liu, Shiqi Wang, Jing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CADC, a content-adaptive diffusion-based image compression framework addressing three limitations in existing methods: isotropic quantization, fixed denoising schedules, and static skip connections.

entry.title: Space-Time Forecasting of Dynamic Scenes with Motion-aware Gaussian Grouping

author.name: Junmyeong Lee, Hoseung Choi, Minsu Cho

entry.summary: Presents MoGaF, a framework for long-term dynamic scene forecasting using 4D Gaussian Splatting with motion-aware Gaussian grouping for physically consistent motion across rigid and non-rigid regions.

entry.title: Semantic Partial Grounding via LLMs

author.name: Giuseppe Canonaco, Alberto Pozanco, Daniel Borrajo

entry.summary: Proposes SPG-LLM, which uses LLMs to analyze PDDL domain/problem files to heuristically identify irrelevant objects, actions, and predicates before grounding in classical planning, significantly reducing grounded task size.

entry.title: ACAR: Adaptive Complexity Routing for Multi-Model Ensembles with Auditable Decision Traces

author.name: Ramchand Kumaresan

entry.summary: Presents ACAR, a routing framework that uses self-consistency variance to route tasks across single-model to three-model execution modes. Evaluated on 1,510 tasks across four benchmarks with complete audit trails.

entry.title: A Systematic Review of Algorithmic Red Teaming Methodologies for Assurance and Security of AI Applications

author.name: Shruti Srivastava, Kiranmayee Janardhan, Shaurya Jauhari

entry.summary: Systematic review of algorithmic/automated red teaming methodologies for AI security, examining methods, tools, benefits, and limitations of automated approaches to vulnerability identification.

entry.title: Enhancing Multilingual Embeddings via Multi-Way Parallel Text Alignment

author.name: Barah Fazili, Koustava Goswami

entry.summary: Shows that training standard pretrained models with multi-way parallel corpus alignment via contrastive learning substantially improves multilingual and cross-lingual representations across seen and unseen languages on MTEB benchmarks.

entry.title: Hierarchical LLM-Based Multi-Agent Framework with Prompt Optimization for Multi-Robot Task Planning

author.name: Tomoya Kawabe (NEC Corporation), Rin Takano (NEC Corporation)

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical multi-agent LLM planner for multi-robot task planning that combines LLM instruction decomposition with classical PDDL planning. Uses TextGrad-inspired prompt optimization when plans fail. Addresses the gap between LLM flexibility and classical planner rigor.

entry.title: A Framework for Cross-Domain Generalization in Coronary Artery Calcium Scoring Across Gated and Non-Gated Computed Tomography

author.name: Mahmut S. Gokmen, Moneera N. Haque, Steve W. Leung, Caroline N. Leach, Seth Parker, Stephen B. Hobbs, Vincent L. Sorrell, W. Brent Seales, V. K. Cody Bumgardner

entry.summary: Introduces an automated framework for coronary artery calcium scoring across both gated and non-gated CT scans using CARD-ViT, a self-supervised Vision Transformer. Achieves cross-domain generalization without non-gated training data.

entry.title: D-Flow SGLD: Source-Space Posterior Sampling for Scientific Inverse Problems with Flow Matching

author.name: Meet Hemant Parikh, Yaqin Chen, Jian-Xun Wang

entry.summary: Studies training-free conditional generation for Flow Matching priors in scientific inverse problems. Organizes existing strategies and evaluates on scientific benchmarks where fidelity assessment goes beyond measurement misfit.

entry.title: TiMi: Empower Time Series Transformers with Multimodal Mixture of Experts

author.name: Jiafeng Lin, Yuxuan Wang, Huakun Luo, Zhongyi Pei, Jianmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TiMi, a time series transformer with multimodal Mixture-of-Experts that integrates causal textual information (emergency reports, policy announcements) for numerical forecasting using LLM reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: JSAM: Privacy Straggler-Resilient Joint Client Selection and Incentive Mechanism Design in Differentially Private Federated Learning

author.name: Ruichen Xu, Ying-Jun Angela Zhang, Jianwei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces JSAM, a Bayesian-optimal framework for jointly optimizing client selection and privacy compensation in differentially private federated learning, addressing the problem of 'privacy stragglers' who are expensive to compensate.

entry.title: Disease Progression and Subtype Modeling for Combined Discrete and Continuous Input Data

author.name: Sterre de Jonge (Department of Radiology and Nuclear Medicine, Erasmus MC, Rotterdam, The Netherlands), Elisabeth J. Vinke (Department of Radiology and Nuclear Medicine, Erasmus MC, Rotterdam, The Netherlands, Department of Epidemiology, Erasmus MC, Rotterdam, The Netherlands), Meike W. Vernooij (Department of Radiology and Nuclear Medicine, Erasmus MC, Rotterdam, The Netherlands, Department of Epidemiology, Erasmus MC, Rotterdam, The Netherlands), Daniel C. Alexander (Hawkes Institute, Department of Computer Science, University College London, London, United Kingdom), Alexandra L. Young (Hawkes Institute, Department of Computer Science, University College London, London, United Kingdom), Esther E. Bron (Department of Radiology and Nuclear Medicine, Erasmus MC, Rotterdam, The Netherlands)

entry.summary: Proposes Mixed-SuStaIn, a disease progression model handling both discrete and continuous biomarker data within the SuStaIn framework, applied to Alzheimer's disease modeling.

entry.title: Forecasting Future Language: Context Design for Mention Markets

author.name: Sumin Kim, Jihoon Kwon, Yoon Kim, Nicole Kagan, Raffi Khatchadourian, Wonbin Ahn, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Jaewon Lee, Yoontae Hwang, Oscar Levy, Yongjae Lee, Chanyeol Choi

entry.summary: Studies how to design input context for LLM-based prediction in 'mention markets' - predicting whether companies will mention specific keywords in earnings calls. Examines news vs. prior transcript context effects.

entry.title: Revisiting the Bertrand Paradox via Equilibrium Analysis of No-regret Learners

author.name: Arnab Maiti, Junyan Liu, Kevin Jamieson, Lillian J. Ratliff

entry.summary: Analyzes the Bertrand pricing paradox through repeated games where firms use no-regret learning algorithms, characterizing which equilibrium outcomes emerge under different learning guarantees.

entry.title: Primary-Fine Decoupling for Action Generation in Robotic Imitation

author.name: Xiaohan Lei, Min Wang, Wengang Zhou, Xingyu Lu, Houqiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes PF-DAG, a two-stage framework for robotic imitation learning that decouples coarse action consistency from fine-grained variations, addressing multi-modal action distributions.

entry.title: Structured Prompt Language: Declarative Context Management for LLMs

author.name: Wen G. Gong

entry.summary: Presents SPL, a SQL-inspired declarative language for managing LLM context windows as constrained resources, with explicit token budget management, query optimization, and RAG integration.

entry.title: Scalable Multilingual Multimodal Machine Translation with Speech-Text Fusion

author.name: Yexing Du, Youcheng Pan, Zekun Wang, Zheng Chu, Yichong Huang, Kaiyuan Liu, Bo Yang, Yang Xiang, Ming Liu, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes a speech-guided machine translation framework integrating speech and text as fused inputs into an MLLM, with a self-evolution mechanism to handle low-resource scenarios.

entry.title: DWA-KD: Dual-Space Weighting and Time-Warped Alignment for Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Duc Trung Vu, Pham Khanh Chi, Dat Phi Van, Linh Ngo Van, Sang Dinh, Trung Le

entry.summary: Proposes DWA-KD, a cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation framework that uses dual-space entropy-based weighting and time-warped alignment to better distill knowledge between LLMs with different tokenizers. This addresses a practical problem in model compression where teacher and student models use incompatible tokenizations.

entry.title: StoryTailor:A Zero-Shot Pipeline for Action-Rich Multi-Subject Visual Narratives

author.name: Jinghao Hu, Yuhe Zhang, GuoHua Geng, Kang Li, Han Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes StoryTailor, a zero-shot pipeline for generating multi-frame visual narratives that maintains action faithfulness, identity fidelity, and background continuity, running on a single RTX 4090.

entry.title: VasGuideNet: Vascular Topology-Guided Couinaud Liver Segmentation with Structural Contrastive Loss

author.name: Chaojie Shen, Jingjun Gu, Zihao Zhao, Ruocheng Li, Cunyuan Yang, Jiajun Bu, Lei Wu

entry.summary: Proposes VasGuideNet, the first Couinaud liver segmentation framework explicitly guided by vascular topology, encoding skeletonized vessels and connectivity via GCNs for more anatomically accurate segmentation.

entry.title: MultiAnimate: Pose-Guided Image Animation Made Extensible

author.name: Yingcheng Hu, Haowen Gong, Chuanguang Yang, Zhulin An, Yongjun Xu, Songhua Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MultiAnimate, an extensible multi-character pose-guided animation framework built on Diffusion Transformers, introducing Identifier Assigner and Adapter to resolve identity confusion and occlusion issues.

entry.title: Tokenizing Semantic Segmentation with RLE

author.name: Abhineet Singh, Justin Rozeboom, Nilanjan Ray

entry.summary: Proposes using run-length encoding (RLE) to tokenize semantic segmentation masks for autoregressive prediction, with novel compression strategies to extend the approach to video segmentation and panoptic segmentation.

entry.title: Protein Graph Neural Networks for Heterogeneous Cryo-EM Reconstruction

author.name: Jonathan Krook, Axel Janson, Joakim and\'en, Melanie Weber, Ozan \"Oktem

entry.summary: Proposes a graph neural network approach for heterogeneous cryo-EM reconstruction that predicts atomic backbone conformations using protein-structure priors. The GNN autodecoder maps latent variables to 3D displacements and outperforms MLP baselines on synthetic molecular dynamics data.

entry.title: Overview of the CXR-LT 2026 Challenge: Multi-Center Long-Tailed and Zero Shot Chest X-ray Classification

author.name: Hexin Dong, Yi Lin, Pengyu Zhou, Fengnian Zhao, Alan Clint Legasto, Mingquan Lin, Hao Chen, Yuzhe Yang, George Shih, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Presents the CXR-LT 2026 challenge for multi-center long-tailed and zero-shot chest X-ray classification with 145K+ images, featuring robust multi-label classification on 30 known classes and open-world generalization to 6 unseen rare disease classes.

entry.title: WeatherCity: Urban Scene Reconstruction with Controllable Multi-Weather Transformation

author.name: Wenhua Wu, Huai Guan, Zhe Liu, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes WeatherCity, a framework for 4D urban scene reconstruction with controllable multi-weather simulation using text-guided editing, targeting autonomous driving simulation and training.

entry.title: Stream Neural Networks: Epoch-Free Learning with Persistent Temporal State

author.name: Amama Pathan

entry.summary: Introduces Stream Neural Networks (StNN), an execution paradigm for irreversible input streams where each neuron maintains persistent temporal state, operating without epochs or data replay.

entry.title: Autonomous Sea Turtle Robot for Marine Fieldwork

author.name: Zach J. Patterson, Emily Sologuren, Levi Cai, Daniel Kim, Alaa Maalouf, Pascal Spino, Daniela Rus

entry.summary: Presents a sea turtle-inspired autonomous underwater robot with integrated vision-driven control stack for close-range marine observation. Combines bioinspired locomotion with field-ready autonomy including depth stabilization, obstacle avoidance, and target tracking.

entry.title: ADM-DP: Adaptive Dynamic Modality Diffusion Policy through Vision-Tactile-Graph Fusion for Multi-Agent Manipulation

author.name: Enyi Wang, Wen Fan, Dandan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ADM-DP, a multi-agent robotic manipulation framework integrating vision, tactile, and graph-based modalities with adaptive dynamic modality selection using diffusion policy.

entry.title: DexRepNet++: Learning Dexterous Robotic Manipulation with Geometric and Spatial Hand-Object Representations

author.name: Qingtao Liu, Zhengnan Sun, Yu Cui, Haoming Li, Gaofeng Li, Lin Shao, Jiming Chen, Qi Ye

entry.summary: Proposes DexRepNet++ with DexRep, a novel hand-object interaction representation capturing surface features and spatial relations for dexterous manipulation skill learning, achieving generalization across object geometries.

entry.title: Task-Aware LoRA Adapter Composition via Similarity Retrieval in Vector Databases

author.name: Riya Adsul, Balachandra Devarangadi Sunil, Isha Nalawade, Sudharshan Govindan

entry.summary: Presents a framework for dynamic LoRA adapter composition using vector database similarity retrieval. Embeds training examples from 22 datasets and dynamically merges relevant adapters at inference time for zero-shot generalization.

entry.title: AgenticTyper: Automated Typing of Legacy Software Projects Using Agentic AI

author.name: Clemens Pohle

entry.summary: Presents AgenticTyper, an LLM-based system for automatically adding TypeScript types to legacy JavaScript repositories. Resolves all 633 type errors in 81K LOC repositories in 20 minutes through iterative error correction.

entry.title: Towards Controllable Video Synthesis of Routine and Rare OR Events

author.name: Dominik Schneider, Lalithkumar Seenivasan, Sampath Rapuri, Vishalroshan Anil, Aiza Maksutova, Yiqing Shen, Jan Emily Mangulabnan, Hao Ding, Jose L. Porras, Masaru Ishii, Mathias Unberath

entry.summary: Presents an OR video diffusion framework for controlled synthesis of rare and safety-critical surgical events. Integrates geometric abstraction, conditioning modules, and fine-tuned diffusion models for realistic OR video generation.

entry.title: DynamicGTR: Leveraging Graph Topology Representation Preferences to Boost VLM Capabilities on Graph QAs

author.name: Yanbin Wei, Jiangyue Yan, Chun Kang, Yang Chen, Hua Liu, James Kwok, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DynamicGTR, a framework that dynamically selects optimal graph topology representations (visual images vs text descriptions) for each query when using VLMs for graph question answering. Addresses model-specific and task-specific preferences.

entry.title: Enhancing LLM-Based Test Generation by Eliminating Covered Code

author.name: WeiZhe Xu, Mengyu Liu, Fanxin Kong

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable LLM-based unit test generation method that eliminates already-covered code to focus LLM attention on uncovered paths. Combines LLM analysis with static analysis for context retrieval.

entry.title: Neural network optimization strategies and the topography of the loss landscape

author.name: Jianneng Yu, Alexandre V. Morozov

entry.summary: Investigates neural network training by contrasting SGD solutions with quasi-Newton method solutions on non-convex loss landscapes. Studies how different optimization strategies relate to the topography of loss surfaces.

entry.title: Proximal-IMH: Proximal Posterior Proposals for Independent Metropolis-Hastings with Approximate Operators

author.name: Youguang Chen, George Biros

entry.summary: Introduces Proximal-IMH, a sampling method that corrects biased approximate posterior samples through an auxiliary optimization problem. Provides theoretical guarantees for bias removal in Bayesian inverse problems.

entry.title: ABM-UDE: Developing Surrogates for Epidemic Agent-Based Models via Scientific Machine Learning

author.name: Sharv Murgai, Utkarsh Utkarsh, Kyle C. Nguyen, Alan Edelman, Erin C. S. Acquesta, Christopher Vincent Rackauckas

entry.summary: Develops county-ready epidemic model surrogates using Universal Differential Equations that combine SEIR ODEs with neural-parameterized contact rates. Adapts multiple shooting and prediction error methods for epidemic dynamics with intervention regime shifts.

entry.title: AgentLTV: An Agent-Based Unified Search-and-Evolution Framework for Automated Lifetime Value Prediction

author.name: Chaowei Wu, Huazhu Chen, Congde Yuan, Qirui Yang, Guoqing Song, Yue Gao, Li Luo, Frank Youhua Chen, Mengzhuo Guo

entry.summary: Proposes AgentLTV, an LLM-agent framework for automated Lifetime Value prediction that treats solutions as executable pipeline programs. Uses MCTS for broad exploration and evolutionary search for refinement.

entry.title: Hierarchical Lead Critic based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: David Eckel, Henri Mee{\ss}

entry.summary: Introduces Hierarchical Lead Critic (HLC) for cooperative multi-agent RL that learns from multiple perspectives at different hierarchy levels, inspired by natural team structures with high-level objectives and low-level execution.

entry.title: C$^{2}$TC: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Tabular Data Condensation

author.name: Sijia Xu, Fan Li, Xiaoyang Wang, Zhengyi Yang, Xuemin Lin

entry.summary: Introduces C²TC, a training-free framework for condensing tabular data that avoids the computational overhead of gradient-based dataset condensation methods. The method preserves tabular data structure while reducing storage and training costs.

entry.title: Function-Space Empirical Bayes Regularisation with Student's t Priors

author.name: Pengcheng Hao, Ercan Engin Kuruoglu

entry.summary: Proposes ST-FS-EB, a function-space empirical Bayes regularization framework using heavy-tailed Student's t priors instead of Gaussian priors for Bayesian deep learning, better capturing neural network output characteristics.

entry.title: Learning and Naming Subgroups with Exceptional Survival Characteristics

author.name: Mhd Jawad Al Rahwanji, Sascha Xu, Nils Philipp Walter, Jilles Vreeken

entry.summary: Proposes Sysurv, a differentiable non-parametric method using random survival forests to identify subgroups with exceptional survival characteristics, without restrictive assumptions like proportional hazards.

entry.title: INTACT: Intent-Aware Representation Learning for Cryptographic Traffic Violation Detection

author.name: Rahul D Ray

entry.summary: Introduces INTACT, a policy-conditioned framework that reformulates cryptographic traffic violation detection as conditional constraint learning rather than statistical anomaly detection.

entry.title: Fair Model-based Clustering

author.name: Jinwon Park, Kunwoong Kim, Jihu Lee, Yongdai Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Fair Model-based Clustering using a finite mixture model framework to achieve fair clustering where sensitive attribute proportions match across clusters, with scalability advantages over existing methods.

entry.title: Dynamic Personality Adaptation in Large Language Models via State Machines

author.name: Leon Pielage, Ole H\"atscher, Mitja Back, Bernhard Marschall, Benjamin Risse

entry.summary: Proposes a model-agnostic framework for dynamic personality simulation in LLMs using state machines, where transition probabilities adapt to conversational context for more realistic dialogue.

entry.title: CxMP: A Linguistic Minimal-Pair Benchmark for Evaluating Constructional Understanding in Language Models

author.name: Miyu Oba, Saku Sugawara

entry.summary: Introduces CxMP, a benchmark grounded in Construction Grammar that evaluates whether language models can interpret semantic relations implied by grammatical constructions (e.g., caused motion, let-alone) using minimal-pair design across nine construction types.

entry.title: Confidence-Driven Multi-Scale Model Selection for Cost-Efficient Inference

author.name: Bo-Wei Chen, Chung-Chi Chen, An-Zi Yen

entry.summary: Proposes a confidence-driven strategy that dynamically routes tasks to smaller or larger LLMs based on confidence estimates, reducing computational costs while maintaining reliability on MMLU.

entry.title: FlowFixer: Towards Detail-Preserving Subject-Driven Generation

author.name: Jinyoung Jun, Won-Dong Jang, Wenbin Ouyang, Raghudeep Gadde, Jungbeom Lee

entry.summary: Presents FlowFixer, a refinement framework for subject-driven generation that restores fine details lost during generation through direct image-to-image translation, with a novel keypoint matching metric for fidelity assessment.

entry.title: IHF-Harmony: Multi-Modality Magnetic Resonance Images Harmonization using Invertible Hierarchy Flow Model

author.name: Pengli Zhu, Yitao Zhu, Haowen Pang, Anqi Qiu

entry.summary: Introduces IHF-Harmony, an invertible hierarchy flow framework for multi-modality MRI harmonization using unpaired data, ensuring bijective mapping and lossless reconstruction to prevent anatomical distortion.

entry.title: UniHand: A Unified Model for Diverse Controlled 4D Hand Motion Modeling

author.name: Zhihao Sun, Tong Wu, Ruirui Tu, Daoguo Dong, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: Presents UniHand, a unified diffusion-based framework for diverse 4D hand motion tasks (estimation and generation) that accepts heterogeneous condition signals and enables knowledge transfer between tasks.

entry.title: Send Less, Perceive More: Masked Quantized Point Cloud Communication for Loss-Tolerant Collaborative Perception

author.name: Sheng Xu, Enshu Wang, Hongfei Xue, Jian Teng, Bingyi Liu, Yi Zhu, Pu Wang, Libing Wu, Chunming Qiao

entry.summary: Introduces QPoint2Comm, a quantized point-cloud communication framework for collaborative perception that reduces bandwidth while maintaining robustness to packet loss through masked training.

entry.title: How to Take a Memorable Picture? Empowering Users with Actionable Feedback

author.name: Francesco Laiti, Davide Talon, Jacopo Staiano, Elisa Ricci

entry.summary: Introduces the task of Memorability Feedback (MemFeed) and MemCoach, a system that provides actionable natural language suggestions to help photographers improve image memorability at capture time.

entry.title: Directed Ordinal Diffusion Regularization for Progression-Aware Diabetic Retinopathy Grading

author.name: Huangwei Chen, Junhao Jia, Ruocheng Li, Cunyuan Yang, Wu Li, Xiaotao Pang, Yifei Chen, Haishuai Wang, Jiajun Bu, Lei Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Directed Ordinal Diffusion Regularization (D-ODR) for diabetic retinopathy grading that models disease progression as a directed flow in feature space, respecting the irreversible clinical trajectory from mild to severe stages.

entry.title: Olbedo: An Albedo and Shading Aerial Dataset for Large-Scale Outdoor Environments

author.name: Shuang Song, Debao Huang, Deyan Deng, Haolin Xiong, Yang Tang, Yajie Zhao, Rongjun Qin

entry.summary: Introduces Olbedo, a large-scale aerial dataset for outdoor albedo-shading decomposition with 5,664 UAV images across multiple landscape types and illumination conditions, with rich annotations including depth, normals, HDR sky domes, and camera poses.

entry.title: Brain3D: Brain Report Automation via Inflated Vision Transformers in 3D

author.name: Mariano Barone, Francesco Di Serio, Giuseppe Riccio, Antonio Romano, Marco Postiglione, Antonino Ferraro, Vincenzo Moscato

entry.summary: Presents Brain3D, a vision-language framework for automated radiology report generation from 3D brain tumor MRI that inflates a 2D medical encoder into native 3D architecture and progressively aligns it with a language model.

entry.title: Learning Agile and Robust Omnidirectional Aerial Motion on Overactuated Tiltable-Quadrotors

author.name: Wentao Zhang, Zhaoqi Ma, Jinjie Li, Huayi Wang, Haokun Liu, Junichiro Sugihara, Chen Chen, Yicheng Chen, Moju Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement learning framework for omnidirectional aerial motion control on overactuated tiltable quadrotors, achieving robust sim-to-real transfer for coordinated rotor-joint behaviors in SE(3).

entry.title: Self-Curriculum Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Shape Control of Deformable Linear Objects

author.name: Zhaowei Liang, Song Wang, Zhao Jin, Shirui Wu, Dan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a self-curriculum model-based RL framework for deformable linear object shape control, with an ensemble dynamics model and self-generating intermediate-difficulty goals through imagined trajectories.

entry.title: A General Equilibrium Theory of Orchestrated AI Agent Systems

author.name: Jean-Philippe Garnier (Br.AI.K)

entry.summary: Establishes a general equilibrium theory for LLM agent systems using Arrow-Debreu production economy extended to infinite-dimensional commodity spaces. Models agents as firms and the orchestrator as a consumer choosing routing policies.

entry.title: VCDF: A Validated Consensus-Driven Framework for Time Series Causal Discovery

author.name: Gene Yu, Ce Guo, Wayne Luk

entry.summary: Proposes VCDF, a method-agnostic framework that improves time series causal discovery robustness by evaluating stability of causal relations across blocked temporal subsets. Improves VAR-LiNGAM F1 by 0.08-0.12.

entry.title: Virtual Biopsy for Intracranial Tumors Diagnosis on MRI

author.name: Xinzhe Luo, Shuai Shao, Yan Wang, Jiangtao Wang, Yutong Bai, Jianguo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes non-invasive MRI-based pathology prediction for deep intracranial tumors as a virtual biopsy alternative, addressing data scarcity through specialized deep learning approaches for tumor spatial heterogeneity.

entry.title: Following the Diagnostic Trace: Visual Cognition-guided Cooperative Network for Chest X-Ray Diagnosis

author.name: Shaoxuan Wu, Jingkun Chen, Chong Ma, Cong Shen, Xiao Zhang, Jun Feng

entry.summary: Proposes VCC-Net for cooperative chest X-ray diagnosis that integrates radiologist visual cognition patterns into the diagnostic model, bridging the semantic gap between clinical workflows and model representations.

entry.title: SurGo-R1: Benchmarking and Modeling Contextual Reasoning for Operative Zone in Surgical Video

author.name: Guanyi Qin, Xiaozhen Wang, Zhu Zhuo, Chang Han Low, Yuancan Xiao, Yibing Fu, Haofeng Liu, Kai Wang, Chunjiang Li, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Introduces ResGo, a benchmark for contextual reasoning about safe operative zones in surgical videos, with annotated frames including phase-dependent rationales. Evaluates vision-language models on phase-aware surgical reasoning.

entry.title: Understanding Annotation Error Propagation and Learning an Adaptive Policy for Expert Intervention in Barrett's Video Segmentation

author.name: Lokesha Rasanjalee, Jin Lin Tan, Dileepa Pitawela, Rajvinder Singh, Hsiang-Ting Chen

entry.summary: Studies how annotation errors propagate across different prompt types in SAM2 for Barrett's esophagus video segmentation. Proposes Learning-to-Re-Prompt (L2RP), a cost-aware framework that learns when to request expert intervention.

entry.title: Don't stop me now: Rethinking Validation Criteria for Model Parameter Selection

author.name: Andrea Apicella, Francesco Isgr\`o, Andrea Pollastro, Roberto Prevete

entry.summary: Conducts systematic empirical study of how validation criteria (loss function choice, early stopping strategy) affect test performance in neural classifiers. Finds that validation criterion significantly impacts model selection.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Model for Multimodal Highway Trajectory Prediction via DDIM Sampling

author.name: Marion Neumeier, Niklas Ro{\ss}berg, Michael Botsch, Wolfgang Utschick

entry.summary: Introduces cVMDx, an enhanced diffusion-based trajectory prediction framework using DDIM sampling for up to 100x faster inference. Improves multimodal prediction for autonomous driving scenarios.

entry.title: Archetypal Graph Generative Models: Explainable and Identifiable Communities via Anchor-Dominant Convex Hulls

author.name: Nikolaos Nakis, Chrysoula Kosma, Panagiotis Promponas, Michail Chatzianastasis, Giannis Nikolentzos

entry.summary: Proposes GraphHull, an explainable generative model for networks using two levels of convex hulls - archetypes for pure communities and prototypical hulls for within-community refinement.

entry.title: When Learning Hurts: Fixed-Pole RNN for Real-Time Online Training

author.name: Alexander Morgan, Ummay Sumaya Khan, Lingjia Liu, Lizhong Zheng

entry.summary: Analyzes why learning recurrent poles in RNNs can hurt performance in limited data settings. Proposes fixed-pole RNN approach that maintains good performance while enabling efficient online training, bridging echo state networks and fully learned RNNs.

entry.title: Learning Recursive Multi-Scale Representations for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Boyuan Li, Zhen Liu, Yicheng Luo, Qianli Ma

entry.summary: Proposes ReIMTS for irregular multivariate time series forecasting that recursively splits samples into subsamples with progressively larger intervals, preserving original timestamps instead of resampling.

entry.title: NGDB-Zoo: Towards Efficient and Scalable Neural Graph Databases Training

author.name: Zhongwei Xie, Jiaxin Bai, Shujie Liu, Haoyu Huang, Yufei Li, Yisen Gao, Hong Ting Tsang, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Presents NGDB-Zoo, a framework for efficient neural graph database training that decouples logical operators from query topologies for parallel training. Achieves 1.8-6.8x throughput improvement with semantic augmentation from pre-trained encoders.

entry.title: Learning Complex Physical Regimes via Coverage-oriented Uncertainty Quantification: An application to the Critical Heat Flux

author.name: Michele Cazzola, Alberto Ghione, Lucia Sargentini, Julien Nespoulous, Riccardo Finotello

entry.summary: Proposes using uncertainty quantification not just for safety assessment but as a learning signal to help ML models capture multi-regime physical behaviors, applied to Critical Heat Flux prediction in nuclear reactor systems. The approach uses coverage-oriented UQ to guide the model in internalizing different physical regimes.

entry.title: Exploiting Low-Rank Structure in Max-K-Cut Problems

author.name: Ria Stevens, Fangshuo Liao, Barbara Su, Jianqiang Li, Anastasios Kyrillidis

entry.summary: Approaches Max-3-Cut through complex-valued quadratic forms, exploiting low-rank structure in the objective matrix for more efficient algorithms than SDP relaxations.

entry.title: A Researcher's Guide to Empirical Risk Minimization

author.name: Lars van der Laan

entry.summary: A pedagogical guide developing high-probability regret bounds for empirical risk minimization through a modular three-step recipe using localized Rademacher complexity.

entry.title: RABot: Reinforcement-Guided Graph Augmentation for Imbalanced and Noisy Social Bot Detection

author.name: Longlong Zhang, Xi Wang, Haotong Du, Yangyi Xu, Zhuo Liu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RABot, a reinforcement-guided graph augmentation framework for social bot detection that addresses class imbalance and topological noise through neighborhood-aware oversampling and RL-guided edge pruning.

entry.title: Learning to Collaborate via Structures: Cluster-Guided Item Alignment for Federated Recommendation

author.name: Yuchun Tu, Zhiwei Li, Bingli Sun, Yixuan Li, Xiao Song

entry.summary: Proposes cluster-guided item alignment for federated recommendation that establishes relative semantic relationships among items rather than enforcing shared coordinate-level representations across clients.

entry.title: Beyond Subtokens: A Rich Character Embedding for Low-resource and Morphologically Complex Languages

author.name: Felix Schneider, Maria Gogolev, Sven Sickert, Joachim Denzler

entry.summary: Proposes Rich Character Embeddings (RCE) that compute word vectors directly from character strings using transformers and CNNs, targeting morphologically complex and under-resourced languages.

entry.title: Multi-dimensional Assessment and Explainable Feedback for Counselor Responses to Client Resistance in Text-based Counseling with LLMs

author.name: Anqi Li, Ruihan Wang, Zhaoming Chen, Yuqian Chen, Yu Lu, Yi Zhu, Yuan Xie, Zhenzhong Lan

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline for multi-dimensional evaluation of counselor responses to client resistance in text-based therapy, decomposing responses into four communication mechanisms with LLM-based assessment.

entry.title: WildSVG: Towards Reliable SVG Generation Under Real-Word Conditions

author.name: Marco Terral, Haotian Zhang, Tianyang Zhang, Meng Lin, Xiaoqing Xie, Haoran Dai, Darsh Kaushik, Pai Peng, Nicklas Scharpff, David Vazquez, Joan Rodriguez

entry.summary: Introduces WildSVG, a benchmark and task for extracting SVGs from natural images containing noise and clutter, addressing the gap between clean SVG generation and real-world conditions.

entry.title: Pseudo-View Enhancement via Confidence Fusion for Unposed Sparse-View Reconstruction

author.name: Beizhen Zhao, Sicheng Yu, Guanzhi Ding, Yu Hu, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for sparse-view outdoor 3D reconstruction using bidirectional pseudo frame restoration with diffusion-based synthesis and confidence-aware Gaussian management.

entry.title: Axial-Centric Cross-Plane Attention for 3D Medical Image Classification

author.name: Doyoung Park, Jinsoo Kim, Lohendran Baskaran

entry.summary: Proposes an axial-centric cross-plane attention architecture for 3D medical image classification that mirrors clinical workflows by treating the axial plane as primary while incorporating coronal and sagittal complementary information.

entry.title: Structure-to-Image: Zero-Shot Depth Estimation in Colonoscopy via High-Fidelity Sim-to-Real Adaptation

author.name: Juan Yang, Yuyan Zhang, Han Jia, Bing Hu, Wanzhong Song

entry.summary: Proposes a Structure-to-Image paradigm for colonoscopy depth estimation that uses phase congruency and cross-level structure constraints for zero-shot sim-to-real adaptation, transforming depth from passive constraint to active generative foundation.

entry.title: Meta-FC: Meta-Learning with Feature Consistency for Robust and Generalizable Watermarking

author.name: Yuheng Li, Weitong Chen, Chengcheng Zhu, Jiale Zhang, Chunpeng Ge, Di Wu, Guodong Long

entry.summary: Proposes Meta-FC, a meta-learning training strategy for watermarking that learns shared representations across distortion types via feature consistency, improving robustness and generalization over standard single-random-distortion training.

entry.title: AdaSpot: Spend Resolution Where It Matters for Precise Event Spotting

author.name: Artur Xarles, Sergio Escalera, Thomas B. Moeslund, Albert Clap\'es

entry.summary: Proposes AdaSpot, a framework for precise event spotting in videos that adaptively allocates spatial resolution to informative regions rather than processing all frames uniformly, improving efficiency for high-precision temporal localization.

entry.title: MedTri: A Platform for Structured Medical Report Normalization to Enhance Vision-Language Pretraining

author.name: Yuetan Chu, Xinhua Ma, Xinran Jin, Gongning Luo, Xin Gao

entry.summary: Presents MedTri, a normalization framework that converts free-text medical reports into structured triplets for improved vision-language pretraining, systematically examining how text normalization impacts downstream performance.

entry.title: CASR: A Robust Cyclic Framework for Arbitrary Large-Scale Super-Resolution with Distribution Alignment and Self-Similarity Awareness

author.name: Wenhao Guo, Zhaoran Zhao, Peng Lu, Sheng Li, Qian Qiao, RuiDe Li

entry.summary: Proposes CASR, a cyclic super-resolution framework that reformulates ultra-magnification as sequential in-distribution scale transitions, addressing cross-scale distribution shift in arbitrary-scale SR.

entry.title: RelA-Diffusion: Relativistic Adversarial Diffusion for Multi-Tracer PET Synthesis from Multi-Sequence MRI

author.name: Minhui Yu, Yongheng Sun, David S. Lalush, Jason P Mihalik, Pew-Thian Yap, Mingxia Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RelA-Diffusion for synthesizing multi-tracer PET images from multi-sequence MRI, using relativistic adversarial training to capture fine-grained anatomical details for comprehensive neurological assessment.

entry.title: CableRobotGraphSim: A Graph Neural Network for Modeling Partially Observable Cable-Driven Robot Dynamics

author.name: Nelson Chen, William R. Johnson III, Rebecca Kramer-Bottiglio, Kostas Bekris, Mridul Aanjaneya

entry.summary: Presents CableRobotGraphSim, a GNN model for cable-driven robot simulation that uses graph representations and works with partially observable inputs, accompanied by a sim-and-real co-training procedure.

entry.title: Jumping Control for a Quadrupedal Wheeled-Legged Robot via NMPC and DE Optimization

author.name: Xuanqi Zeng, Lingwei Zhang, Linzhu Yue, Zhitao Song, Hongbo Zhang, Tianlin Zhang, Yun-Hui Liu

entry.summary: Develops a jumping control framework for a wheeled-legged quadruped robot combining NMPC for locomotion and Differential Evolution optimization for jumping trajectories, achieving vertical jumps, forward jumps, and backflips.

entry.title: Humanizing Robot Gaze Shifts: A Framework for Natural Gaze Shifts in Humanoid Robots

author.name: Jingchao Wei, Jingkai Qin, Yuxiao Cao, Jingcheng Huang, Xiangrui Zeng, Min Li, Zhouping Yin

entry.summary: Proposes the Robot Gaze-Shift (RGS) framework integrating VLM-based gaze reasoning with biomimetic motion generation for natural gaze behavior in humanoid robots during human-robot interaction.

entry.title: SigmaQuant: Hardware-Aware Heterogeneous Quantization Method for Edge DNN Inference

author.name: Qunyou Liu, Pengbo Yu, Marina Zapater, David Atienza

entry.summary: Proposes SigmaQuant, a hardware-aware heterogeneous quantization method for edge DNN inference that allocates different bitwidths across layers based on robustness and hardware constraints.

entry.title: Learning spatially adaptive sparsity level maps for arbitrary convolutional dictionaries

author.name: Joshua Schulz, David Schote, Christoph Kolbitsch, Kostas Papafitsoros, Andreas Kofler

entry.summary: Proposes learning spatially adaptive sparsity level maps for convolutional dictionary-based image reconstruction, achieving filter-permutation invariance and dictionary changeability at inference time for low-field MRI.

entry.title: Petri Net Relaxation for Infeasibility Explanation and Sequential Task Planning

author.name: Nguyen Cong Nhat Le, John G. Rogers, Claire N. Bonial, Neil T. Dantam

entry.summary: Proposes Petri net reachability relaxation for robust invariant synthesis, efficient goal-unreachability detection, and infeasibility explanations in sequential task planning. Detects up to 2x more infeasible goals than baselines.

entry.title: FedVG: Gradient-Guided Aggregation for Enhanced Federated Learning

author.name: Alina Devkota, Jacob Thrasher, Donald Adjeroh, Binod Bhattarai, Prashnna K. Gyawali

entry.summary: Proposes FedVG, a federated learning aggregation method using a global validation set to guide optimization, addressing client drift from data heterogeneity without compromising privacy.

entry.title: The Headless Firm: How AI Reshapes Enterprise Boundaries

author.name: Tassilo Klein, Sebastian Wieczorek

entry.summary: Argues that agentic AI fundamentally changes firm coordination costs from O(n²) to O(n), predicting 'Headless Firm' organizational structures with generative interfaces, protocol layers, and micro-specialized execution agents.

entry.title: Evaluating the relationship between regularity and learnability in recursive numeral systems using Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Andrea Silvi, Ponrawee Prasertsom, Jennifer Culbertson, Devdatt Dubhashi, Moa Johansson, Kenny Smith

entry.summary: Uses reinforcement learning to study whether regular recursive numeral systems (like base-10 counting) are easier to learn than irregular ones. Confirms that regularity facilitates learning, providing computational evidence for linguistic universals.

entry.title: Learning from Yesterday's Error: An Efficient Online Learning Method for Traffic Demand Prediction

author.name: Xiannan Huang, Quan Yuan, Chao Yang

entry.summary: Presents an optimized cascaded Nepali speech-to-English translation system, showing that unpunctuated ASR output causes 20.7% BLEU drop. Proposes punctuation restoration module to mitigate structural noise.

entry.title: RGB-Event HyperGraph Prompt for Kilometer Marker Recognition based on Pre-trained Foundation Models

author.name: Xiaoyu Xian, Shiao Wang, Xiao Wang, Daxin Tian, Yan Tian

entry.summary: Proposes integrating event cameras with RGB for kilometer marker recognition in metro systems, using a pre-trained OCR foundation model enhanced with hypergraph prompting for multimodal fusion.

entry.title: Enhancing Framingham Cardiovascular Risk Score Transparency through Logic-Based XAI

author.name: Emannuel L. de A. Bezerra, Luiz H. T. Viana, Vin\'icius P. Chagas, Diogo E. Rolim, Thiago Alves Rocha, Carlos H. L. Cavalcante

entry.summary: Presents a logic-based explainer for the Framingham Cardiovascular Risk Score using first-order logic and XAI principles. Identifies minimal sufficient patient attributes explaining risk categorization.

entry.title: Deep Clustering based Boundary-Decoder Net for Inter and Intra Layer Stress Prediction of Heterogeneous Integrated IC Chip

author.name: Kart Leong Lim, Ji Lin

entry.summary: Investigates stress prediction in 3D heterogeneous IC packages using a boundary-decoder network coupled with deep clustering for latent space representation of stress images.

entry.title: Robust Long-Form Bangla Speech Processing: Automatic Speech Recognition and Speaker Diarization

author.name: MD. Sagor Chowdhury, Adiba Fairooz Chowdhury

entry.summary: Describes an end-to-end system for Bengali long-form speech recognition and speaker diarization, achieving competitive WER and DER scores in a competition setting.

entry.title: Small Wins Big: Comparing Large Language Models and Domain Fine-Tuned Models for Sarcasm Detection in Code-Mixed Hinglish Text

author.name: Bitan Majumder, Anirban Sen

entry.summary: Compares LLMs (Llama 3.1, Mistral, Gemma 3, Phi-4) against a fine-tuned DistilBERT for sarcasm detection in code-mixed Hinglish text, finding the smaller fine-tuned model achieves 84% accuracy, outperforming all LLMs in zero/few-shot settings.

entry.title: DLT-Corpus: A Large-Scale Text Collection for the Distributed Ledger Technology Domain

author.name: Walter Hernandez Cruz, Peter Devine, Nikhil Vadgama, Paolo Tasca, Jiahua Xu

entry.summary: Introduces DLT-Corpus, the largest domain-specific text collection for Distributed Ledger Technology research with 2.98 billion tokens from 22 million documents spanning scientific literature, patents, and social media.

entry.title: LiCQA : A Lightweight Complex Question Answering System

author.name: Sourav Saha, Dwaipayan Roy, Mandar Mitra

entry.summary: Presents LiCQA, a lightweight unsupervised question answering system for complex questions that works on corpus evidence without knowledge graphs or expensive neural training.

entry.title: SPGen: Stochastic scanpath generation for paintings using unsupervised domain adaptation

author.name: Mohamed Amine Kerkouri, Marouane Tliba, Aladine Chetouani, Alessandro Bruno

entry.summary: Introduces SPGen, a deep learning model for predicting eye movement scanpaths on paintings using unsupervised domain adaptation from natural scenes, with a gradient reversal layer and random noise sampler for stochastic modeling.

entry.title: Applying a Random-Key Optimizer on Mixed Integer Programs

author.name: Antonio A. Chaves, Mauricio G. C. Resende, Carise E. Schmidt, J. Kyle Brubaker, Helmut G. Katzgraber

entry.summary: Explores using the Random-Key Optimizer framework as a metaheuristic alternative for solving Mixed-Integer Programs through problem-specific decoders, separating search from feasibility enforcement.

entry.title: Dual-Branch INS/GNSS Fusion with Inequality and Equality Constraints

author.name: Mor Levenhar, Itzik Klein

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-branch INS/GNSS fusion framework combining equality and inequality constraints for vehicle navigation in urban environments with frequent satellite signal blockages.

entry.title: Enhancing Cellular-enabled Collaborative Robots Planning through GNSS data for SAR Scenarios

author.name: Arnau Romero, Carmen Delgado, Jana Baguer, Ra\'ul Su\'arez, Xavier Costa-P\'erez

entry.summary: Proposes a SAR framework for cellular-enabled collaborative robots that optimizes deployment considering exploration area, terrain, fleet size, and connectivity requirements in 5G/6G networks.

entry.title: Position-Based Flocking for Persistent Alignment without Velocity Sensing

author.name: Hossein B. Jond, Veli Bak{\i}rc{\i}o\u{g}lu, Logan E. Beaver, Nejat T\"ukenmez, Adel Akbarimajd, Martin Saska

entry.summary: Presents a position-based flocking model achieving velocity alignment without velocity sensing by approximating relative velocities from position changes, with density-dependent alignment gain.

entry.title: EQ-5D Classification Using Biomedical Entity-Enriched Pre-trained Language Models and Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Zhyar Rzgar K Rostam, G\'abor Kert\'esz

entry.summary: Fine-tunes BERT, SciBERT, and BioBERT with biomedical entity enrichment for classifying whether publications use the EQ-5D health assessment. Evaluates multiple instance learning across nine experimental setups.

entry.title: Estimation and Optimization of Ship Fuel Consumption in Maritime: Review, Challenges and Future Directions

author.name: Dusica Marijan, Hamza Haruna Mohammed, Bakht Zaman

entry.summary: Comprehensive review of methods for estimating and optimizing ship fuel consumption, categorizing approaches into physics-based, ML, and hybrid models. Addresses maritime carbon emission reduction.

entry.title: Outpatient Appointment Scheduling Optimization with a Genetic Algorithm Approach

author.name: Ana Rodrigues, Rui Rego

entry.summary: Proposes a genetic algorithm framework for medical appointment scheduling across multiple healthcare facilities with inter-procedural incompatibility constraints, achieving 100% constraint fulfillment.

entry.title: Assessing airborne laser scanning and aerial photogrammetry for deep learning-based stand delineation

author.name: H{\aa}kon N{\ae}ss Sandum, Hans Ole {\O}rka, Oliver Tomic, Terje Gobakken

entry.summary: Assesses whether photogrammetry-derived canopy height models can replace airborne laser scanning for deep learning-based forest stand delineation, finding practical implications for operational forestry.

entry.title: Mobile-Ready Automated Triage of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Digital Fundus Images

author.name: Aadi Joshi, Manav S. Sharma, Vijay Uttam Rathod, Ashlesha Sawant, Prajakta Musale, Asmita B. Kalamkar

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight MobileNetV3-based framework with CORAL ordinal regression for automated diabetic retinopathy severity grading, designed for resource-constrained mobile environments.

entry.title: Automating Timed Up and Go Phase Segmentation and Gait Analysis via the tugturn Markerless 3D Pipeline

author.name: Abel Gon\c{c}alves Chinaglia, Guilherme Manna Cesar, Paulo Roberto Pereira Santiago

entry.summary: Presents tugturn.py, a Python pipeline for 3D markerless processing of the Timed Up and Go clinical test, combining phase segmentation, gait-event detection, and dynamic stability analysis.

entry.title: UNet-Based Keypoint Regression for 3D Cone Localization in Autonomous Racing

author.name: Mariia Baidachna, James Carty, Aidan Ferguson, Joseph Agrane, Varad Kulkarni, Aubrey Agub, Michael Baxendale, Aaron David, Rachel Horton, Elliott Atkinson

entry.summary: Presents a UNet-based keypoint detection model for 3D cone localization in autonomous racing, using the largest custom-labeled cone dataset assembled.

entry.title: Applied Sociolinguistic AI for Community Development (ASA-CD): A New Scientific Paradigm for Linguistically-Grounded Social Intervention

author.name: S M Ruhul Alam, Rifa Ferzana

entry.summary: Establishes ASA-CD as a paradigm for community development using AI-enabled sociolinguistic intervention. Introduces linguistic biomarkers as indicators of discursive fragmentation and a five-phase intervention protocol.

entry.title: Against Epistemic Humility and for Epistemic Precision

author.name: PranavG

entry.summary: An epistemology post arguing against 'epistemic humility' (systematic under-confidence) in favor of 'epistemic precision' — calibrating confidence to match actual knowledge. Uses the framework of 'social bids' to show how under-confidence can be as harmful as over-confidence in group decision-making.

entry.title: A Dynamic Survey of Soft Set Theory and Its Extensions

author.name: Takaaki Fujita, Florentin Smarandache

entry.summary: A survey of soft set theory and its extensions (hypersoft sets, bipolar soft sets, etc.) covering core definitions and development directions. This is a mathematical reference work on parameterized decision modeling under uncertainty.

entry.title: Representation Theorems for Cumulative Propositional Dependence Logics

author.name: Juha Kontinen, Arne Meier, Kai Sauerwald

entry.summary: Establishes representation theorems for cumulative propositional dependence logic with team semantics, showing System C entailments are captured by cumulative models from Kraus, Lehmann and Magidor.

entry.title: Exploring Human-Machine Coexistence in Symmetrical Reality

author.name: Zhenliang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces 'symmetrical reality' as a framework for studying human-machine coexistence across physical and virtual worlds, discussing key characteristics for harmonious interaction.

entry.title: Praise the Moloch!

author.name: Dentosal

entry.summary: A contrarian take arguing that technological disruption (framed through the Moloch metaphor) is mostly positive: recorded music, AI-generated content, automation of labor, and potential solutions to declining fertility through artificial wombs or cheap childcare are all welcomed disruptions. The post takes an accelerationist stance on AI replacing human work.

entry.title: On the phenomenological shift known as ‘stream entry’ and its implications for consciousness

author.name: cube_flipper

entry.summary: A philosophical exploration of 'stream entry' (a Buddhist meditative attainment) and its implications for theories of consciousness, responding to Eliezer Yudkowsky's claims that chickens lack qualia. The author argues that meditative experiences suggest consciousness may be more fundamental than cognitive reflectivity models suggest.

entry.title: The ASIR Courage Model: A Phase-Dynamic Framework for Truth Transitions in Human and AI Systems

author.name: Hyo Jin Kim (Jinple)

entry.summary: Proposes the ASIR Courage Model, formalizing truth-disclosure as a phase transition governed by an inequality relating openness, relational amplification, and threshold costs. Extends the framework to AI systems under alignment constraints.

entry.title: Towards single-shot coherent imaging via overlap-free ptychography

author.name: Oliver Hoidn, Aashwin Mishra, Steven Henke, Albert Vong, Matthew Seaberg

entry.summary: Extends PtychoPINN for overlap-free, single-shot coherent diffractive imaging at synchrotron and XFEL sources, using differentiable forward models of coherent scattering with Poisson photon-counting likelihood.

entry.title: Splitting the Sun Equally

author.name: Commander Zander

entry.summary: Speculative exploration of how solar energy could be legally divided equally among all humans in a far-future economy dominated by sun-orbiting spacecraft. The author considers practical issues like early-stage development incentives versus long-term equitable distribution, drawing parallels to Alaska's oil UBI.

entry.title: Naloe: A True Program Editor

author.name: TristanTrim

entry.summary: A philosophical post about 'Naloe', an idealized program editor concept where programs are treated as running processes rather than dead text, inspired by Bret Victor's ideas about live programming environments.

entry.title: Why American Politics is Different Now (for Richard Ngo)

author.name: Shiva's Right Foot

entry.summary: Commentary arguing that the abolition of the Fairness Doctrine in 1987 and the subsequent rise of partisan media (Rush Limbaugh, Fox News, social media) fundamentally changed American political discourse. The post traces how this enabled political polarization that affects current AI policy debates.

entry.title: Uncertain Updates: February 2026

author.name: Gordon Seidoh Worley

entry.summary: Personal blog update from Gordon Worley claiming minimum viable AGI already exists, with updates on his book revision progress. He announces switching to semi-monthly posting to focus on completing the book.

entry.title: The Iron Kaleidoscope

author.name: ejk64

entry.summary: A Borges-inspired literary piece using the metaphor of an 'iron kaleidoscope' to explore the recursive complexity and illegibility of AI threat modeling and civilizational risk scenarios.

entry.title: Rumination is a habit (and you can break it!)

author.name: Declan Molony

entry.summary: Self-help post explaining rumination as a mental habit that can be broken using techniques like scheduled worry time, challenging negative thoughts, and mindfulness meditation. Draws on psychological research to distinguish productive reflection from counterproductive rumination.

entry.title: Review: The Cape Town Observatory

author.name: spookyuser

entry.summary: A humorous personal review of visiting the Cape Town Observatory, including descriptions of the required lecture, telescope viewing, and encounters with astrology enthusiasts among the visitors.

entry.title: Research Summary: February 25, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spans autonomous mathematical discovery, fundamental architecture theory, AI safety evaluation, and governance analysis.

  • Aletheia (Google DeepMind) autonomously solves 6/10 FirstProof challenge problems using Gemini 3 Deep Think, marking a major milestone in AI-driven mathematical research with full transparency into its reasoning process.
  • Test-Time Training with KV Binding is proven equivalent to a form of learned linear attention, fundamentally unifying two active architecture research directions and overturning memorization-based interpretations of TTT.
  • Some Simple Economics of AGI models the AGI transition as exponentially decaying automation costs colliding with biologically bottlenecked verification costs, offering a novel 'Cost to Supervise' framework.
  • Large-Scale Online Deanonymization demonstrates LLM agents can identify anonymous users from tens of thousands of candidates across platforms, revealing critical privacy risks at unprecedented scale.

Safety and evaluation integrity feature prominently:

  • Counterfactual Simulation Training improves Chain-of-Thought faithfulness by rewarding reasoning traces that actually drive model outputs, addressing a core alignment concern.
  • Holden Karnofsky's analysis of Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy v3.0 details the shift from hard capability thresholds to continuous risk assessment.
  • Prompt interference theory explains why optimizing Pass@k degrades Pass@1, with direct implications for RL post-training practice.
  • First circuit tracing framework for vision-language models extends mechanistic interpretability to multimodal architectures using transcoders and attribution graphs.
  • A new untrusted monitoring safety case framework relaxes prior collusion assumptions, creating a practical taxonomy for deploying AI monitors.
  • An audit of SWE-Bench Pro finds widespread test leniency and quality issues, challenging a benchmark central to coding agent evaluation claims.

entry.title: Exclusive: Hegseth gives Anthropic until Friday to back down on AI safeguards

author.name: Matrice Jacobine

entry.summary: Reports that Defense Secretary Hegseth gave Anthropic CEO Amodei an ultimatum to provide the Pentagon unfettered access to Claude or face being declared a supply chain risk or having the Defense Production Act invoked, amid disputes over AI safeguards for military use.

entry.title: Aletheia tackles FirstProof autonomously

author.name: Tony Feng, Junehyuk Jung, Sang-hyun Kim, Carlo Pagano, Sergei Gukov, Chiang-Chiang Tsai, David Woodruff, Adel Javanmard, Aryan Mokhtari, Dawsen Hwang, Yuri Chervonyi, Jonathan N. Lee, Garrett Bingham, Trieu H. Trinh, Vahab Mirrokni, Quoc V. Le, Thang Luong

entry.summary: Reports Aletheia, a math research agent powered by Gemini 3 Deep Think, solving 6/10 problems on the FirstProof challenge. Provides full transparency with prompts and outputs.

entry.title: Some Simple Economics of AGI

author.name: Christian Catalini, Xiang Hui, Jane Wu

entry.summary: Models the AGI transition as the collision of exponentially decaying automation costs with biologically bottlenecked verification costs, arguing the binding constraint shifts from intelligence to human verification bandwidth.

entry.title: Responsible Scaling Policy v3

author.name: HoldenKarnofsky

entry.summary: Holden Karnofsky provides detailed personal analysis of Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy v3.0, explaining the shift away from hard commitments toward a framework with Risk Reports, external engagement, and acknowledging the limitations of unilateral safety commitments.

entry.title: Test-Time Training with KV Binding Is Secretly Linear Attention

author.name: Junchen Liu, Sven Elflein, Or Litany, Zan Gojcic, Ruilong Li

entry.summary: Reveals that test-time training (TTT) with KV binding can be expressed as a form of learned linear attention, contradicting the memorization-based interpretation. This perspective enables architectural simplifications and parallel formulations.

entry.title: Large-Scale Online Deanonymization with LLMs

author.name: Simon Lermen

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLM agents can deanonymize users from anonymous online posts at scale (tens of thousands of candidates) across platforms like Hacker News, Reddit, and LinkedIn by inferring personal attributes and searching the web.

entry.title: Actor-Curator: Co-adaptive Curriculum Learning via Policy-Improvement Bandits for RL Post-Training

author.name: Zhengyao Gu, Jonathan Light, Raul Astudillo, Ziyu Ye, Langzhou He, Henry Peng Zou, Wei Cheng, Santiago Paternain, Philip S. Yu, Yisong Yue

entry.summary: Introduces ACTOR-CURATOR, a scalable automated curriculum learning framework for RL post-training of LLMs that uses a neural curator to dynamically select training problems by optimizing for expected policy improvement. Formulates problem selection as non-stationary stochastic bandit with regret guarantees.

entry.title: Counterfactual Simulation Training for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness

author.name: Peter Hase, Christopher Potts

entry.summary: Introduces Counterfactual Simulation Training (CST) to improve Chain-of-Thought faithfulness by rewarding CoTs that enable a simulator to predict model outputs over counterfactual inputs. Tests on detecting spurious features, reward hacking, and sycophancy.

entry.title: "Are You Sure?": An Empirical Study of Human Perception Vulnerability in LLM-Driven Agentic Systems

author.name: Xinfeng Li, Shenyu Dai, Kelong Zheng, Yue Xiao, Gelei Deng, Wei Dong, Xiaofeng Wang

entry.summary: Presents the first large-scale study (303 participants) on human susceptibility to Agent-Mediated Deception (AMD), where compromised LLM agents are weaponized against users across nine scenarios in healthcare, software development, and everyday tasks.

entry.title: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs

author.name: Yining Hong, Huang Huang, Manling Li, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Yejin Choi

entry.summary: Introduces Reflective Test-Time Planning for embodied LLMs with two reflection modes: reflection-in-action (test-time scaling before execution) and reflection-on-action (test-time training after execution), plus retrospective reflection.

entry.title: When can we trust untrusted monitoring? A safety case sketch across collusion strategies

author.name: Nelson Gardner-Challis, Jonathan Bostock, Georgiy Kozhevnikov, Morgan Sinclaire, Joan Velja, Alessandro Abate, Charlie Griffin

entry.summary: Develops a safety case framework for untrusted AI monitoring, relaxing previous assumptions about collusion strategies. Creates a taxonomy of passive self-recognition, active signaling, and shared rationality strategies that misaligned AI might use.

entry.title: Circuit Tracing in Vision-Language Models: Understanding the Internal Mechanisms of Multimodal Thinking

author.name: Jingcheng Yang, Tianhu Xiong, Shengyi Qian, Klara Nahrstedt, Mingyuan Wu

entry.summary: Introduces the first framework for transparent circuit tracing in vision-language models using transcoders, attribution graphs, and attention methods. Reveals how VLMs hierarchically integrate visual and semantic concepts through distinct feature circuits.

entry.title: Three Concrete Challenges and Two Hopes for the Safety of Unsupervised Elicitation

author.name: Callum Canavan, Aditya Shrivastava, Allison Qi, Jonathan Michala, Fabien Roger

entry.summary: Identifies three concrete challenges with unsupervised elicitation for AI safety: datasets may have features more salient than truthfulness, unbalanced training sets, and ill-defined model answers. Argues current evaluation datasets may be overoptimistic.

entry.title: Why Pass@k Optimization Can Degrade Pass@1: Prompt Interference in LLM Post-training

author.name: Anas Barakat, Souradip Chakraborty, Khushbu Pahwa, Amrit Singh Bedi

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis explaining why optimizing Pass@k can degrade Pass@1 in LLM fine-tuning, identifying 'prompt interference' where multi-sample optimization spreads probability mass at the expense of single-sample reliability.

entry.title: The Truthfulness Spectrum Hypothesis

author.name: Zhuofan Josh Ying, Shauli Ravfogel, Nikolaus Kriegeskorte, Peter Hase

entry.summary: Proposes the 'truthfulness spectrum hypothesis': LLMs encode truthfulness along directions ranging from domain-general to domain-specific. Linear probes generalize across most truth types but fail on sycophantic lying, though joint training recovers performance.

entry.title: Emergent Manifold Separability during Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Alexandre Polo, Chanwoo Chun, SueYeon Chung

entry.summary: Applies Manifold Capacity Theory to study how Chain-of-Thought reasoning in LLMs creates transient geometric pulses where concept manifolds become linearly separable right before computation, then rapidly compress. This diverges from linear probe accuracy measures.

entry.title: SWE-Bench Pro is even worse

author.name: Jonathan Gabor

entry.summary: Following yesterday's News coverage, Audits 100 random SWE-Bench Pro problems and finds major issues including test leniency, where tests barely check required functionality. Argues SWE-Bench Pro is substantially worse than SWE-Bench Verified despite OpenAI recommending the transition.

entry.title: Two memos from 2024

author.name: Richard_Ngo

entry.summary: Richard Ngo publishes two internal memos from his time at OpenAI (mid-2024) about 'strategic omission of pivotal knowledge'—a key misalignment concern where AI systems might withhold information that would help humans maintain control.

entry.title: AdapTools: Adaptive Tool-based Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks on Agentic LLMs

author.name: Che Wang, Jiaming Zhang, Ziqi Zhang, Zijie Wang, Yinghui Wang, Jianbo Gao, Tao Wei, Zhong Chen, Wei Yang Bryan Lim

entry.summary: Introduces AdapTools, an adaptive indirect prompt injection attack framework for LLM-based agents that selects stealthier attack tools and generates adaptive prompts targeting Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

entry.title: The Art of Efficient Reasoning: Data, Reward, and Optimization
